title: Shinonome Akito — Card Story

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sigh...
Why can't Ena go to the convenience store herself?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sheesh, does she think it's fine as long as she pays?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But thanks to that, we were able to buy some cheesecake. I've never had convenience store cheesecake before. It's surprisingly nice.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I know! The one they sell here is one of my favorites.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yup, it's good. I could eat this every day.

rows.Speaker: Samo
rows.Line: Woof woof!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Guh?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
S-Samo, wait!
Slow down, please!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's a really big dog...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, it sure is...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, nothing.

rows.Speaker: Samo
rows.Line: Woof woof!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Why are you heading there?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Argh?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Akito... Are you maybe...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hey, come here.

rows.Speaker: Samo
rows.Line: Woof! Sniff sniff...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He's sniffing. Do you smell something nice on us?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry!
Samo just suddenly wanted to come here for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is it because of the cheesecake we ate just now?

rows.Speaker: Samo
rows.Line: Woof!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? You want me to pet you?

rows.Speaker: Samo
rows.Line: Woooof...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
He's really friendly.
What breed is he?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
He's a Samoyed!
All Samoyeds are large and fluffy!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, his fur is soft and fluffy... He's a cute dog.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Samo, we have to go now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm so sorry he scared you like that!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, don't worry about it.
I was just caught off guard, that's all.

rows.Speaker: Samo
rows.Line: Woof woof!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ugh!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: See you, Samo.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Aren't you glad the nice man gave you so many pets, Samo?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No problem.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Be careful on your way home!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We will!

rows.Speaker: Samo
rows.Line: Woof woof!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Uh huh.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Nothing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Liar. You were laughing at me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I wasn't laughing at you.
It's just you're scared of dogs, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I'm not scared of dogs. It's just...
I was bitten by a dog. A long time ago.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You're definitely laughing at me.
Sheesh...
Kamiyama High School - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What was that noise just now...
What the heck, Rui?! Was that an explosion?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It came from the courtyard?
Kamiyama High School - Courtyard
That was definitely gunpowder! You used gunpowder?!

Oh, I would never!
We're in school, you know.
Don't act dumb! Why was there an explosion, then?!
And look! Look at how frizzy my hair's become!
Don't worry, it's not that much different than before.
That's what you think!

rows.Speaker: Teacher A
rows.Line: You two again?!
Uh oh, the teacher's here! We should run—
What, he's gone?!
Hahahaha☆
Y-You heartless traitor!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What was that?

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line:
That's Tenma and Kamishiro, right?
They've got quite a reputation among the second years.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: I think they're known as the Weirdo Wombo Combo or something like that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Weirdo Wombo Combo?
That's just...tacky.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I didn't know we had looneys like that in this school. I'm gonna have to stay far, far away from them...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, are you here?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? What's the matter?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's nothing particularly important, but can you accompany me somewhere after school?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure, what's up, though?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There's an upperclassman I'd like to introduce you to.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Upperclassman?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Someone who's helped me out a lot since I was little. I'd really like you meet him too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He used to play the piano as well, and we often played piano duets together for fun.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
His musical acumen is truly profound.
I have the greatest respect for him as a person.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm... An upperclassman you respect, huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's unusual for Toya to have that sort of expression on his face when he's talking about classical music...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'd definitely want to meet someone who's earned that much respect from you.
After school

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He's waiting for us in one of the second-year classrooms.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's his name, anyway?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: His name is Tsukasa. Tsukasa Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay... Hm? Tenma?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Now where have I heard that name before...)
Class 2-C

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry for the intrusion.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm? Your bangs are really singed, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No thanks to you! Ugh...
How do I get them back to normal...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Ack! That's the Weirdo Wombo Combo I saw during lunch! Of all the places to bump into them...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry to keep you waiting, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Now wait a minute... Don't tell me...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, you're here, Toya! I've been waiting for you!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you so much for making some time for me today.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hahahaha!
Don't be so formal! We're friends, aren't we?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oho, you must be Toya Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A fine, earnest-looking young man like yourself having such great esteem for someone as eccentric as him, hm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Who're you calling eccentric?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, this is the upperclassman I told you about during lunch break. The one I have the utmost respect for.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Th-This must be a bad dream...
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I got here faster than I expected...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess I can pass the time before Toya gets here by checking the recording from the other day.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (The intro's fine, and the next part has a good build-up too.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But the moment we enter the chorus sucks.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Sigh... Every time, there's just something off with it.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, looks like I kept you waiting.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sup, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Listen to this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I need your opinion on the chorus here and also at the end.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That's the start of the chorus... Hmm, that's odd.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There's no change of pace between the verse and the chorus, so it's not very satisfying, is that it?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I was just thinking that there was something off about it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
So you're saying it's the pace?
I guess that's it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But you've picked up on that, so you can fix it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There's also that last chorus...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's quieter than the rest of the song.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Aah, of course!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Crap... This makes me sound like a total amateur.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't think anyone would notice unless they were actively listening out for mistakes.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, as if. I've got to do better than that.
Besides, you'd notice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I suppose so...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: See?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And I'd hate that more than anything.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Besides, nowadays we often sing together with Kohane and An.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Even if they don't have your perfect hearing, they'll be able to tell something wasn't right.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You may be right about the crowd, they may not notice.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But it'd bug the heck out of me knowing you guys can hear me putting on a subpar performance.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why are you staring at me like this?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No reason.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You don't stare at people for no reason.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Just say it. It's gonna bother me now if you don't.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Some emotion is peering through your poker face for a change, so don't try to cover it up.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He's my partner. I need to know what he's thinking.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, I'm just waiting for you to tell me what's on your mind, so hurry it up.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It wasn't anything important. I was just mildly shocked that you indirectly admitted you think highly of Azusawa and Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Can't deny they're two of the best singers our age I've met.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's high praise coming from you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, it's just a fact.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, let's start our practice.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Bear with me until I get all the kinks ironed out in my part. I'm not going to give a half-baked performance when our next gig comes up.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, of course.
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: New stuff came in, I see. Probably for the new season.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Manager! I'm going to open those boxes.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Can you put the new outfits on display too?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (A perk of working here is that I get to check out the new arrivals before anyone else.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'll take my time inspecting the goods while there are no customers...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Will Shinonome be in?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: He normally works this shift... There he is!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ugh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Uh, h-hello, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Told you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I figured out his shift schedule based on when he comes to my dad's cafe!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow! That's some neat detective work, An!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If you're not buying anything, can you just leave?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Don't try to chase out your customers.
Oh, it's the manager! Haven't seen you in a while!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Hello, An.
You brought a friend today?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's right! She's—

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Sorry, I've got to take this call!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: You look after our customers, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sigh... What a pain in the neck...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oooh, what sort of attitude is that for a staff member?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Get off my back, An. What do you guys want?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... I'm... I'm looking for some new clothes...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What sort?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Well... Something stylish, like what An wears, that I could use for our gigs...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright. I've got this, and this. Which one do you like?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You want me to choose from these two? In that case, the one on the right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay. Now, this one or that one?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The one on the left?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hmph, you're quick to make up your mind.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I got an idea of what your taste is like. Wait here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
How's this?
It goes well with the other items.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wow, that's so cool!
Thanks, Shinonome!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, that looks good.
Why don't you try it on, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh yeah! Is that okay?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The fitting rooms are that way.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see. Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Handle the stuff with care, though.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That shirt you're holding in your left hand's a hundred thousand yen.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: R-Really?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Damage it or get dirt on it and you'll have to pay compensation.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: C-Compensation?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, this store caters to high school kids. There's no way they'd carry items that expensive.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You just had to ruin my fun, didn't you?
Meh, whatever. Go try the outfit on, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I put it on... How does it look?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... It looks big on you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. The colors match fine, though.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Can you find her a smaller size in a similar color?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Hmph. Her fashion sense isn't bad.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I've got something that fits the bill. Here, try this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, this is nice!
It's just right! Try it on, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hmm?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I, um...wanted to thank you.
For helping me pick a new outfit.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's my job. And besides...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I had to make sure you don't buy a horrible outfit and damage the store's rep.
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you for visiting!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(That was the last customer.
I should have a bit of leeway now to...hm?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Toya's already outside, which means my shift is probably almost over.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I should finish some urgent stuff first before leaving.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks for the day, everyone!
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry, were you waiting long?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're just on time. Don't worry about it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Great. So, about our next event...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The set list from the previous show felt pretty good. I think we can stick with that and...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What is it? Why do you keep staring at me? Is there something on my face or what?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I was just thinking about how expressive you are.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What? What's that supposed to mean?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Your smile is so soft when entertaining customers, but you also tend to look scary from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Scary... That's a pretty mean way of putting it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But it's true.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, I'll admit I may put on a scary face sometimes...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That reminds me. When we first started singing together, your face would sometimes turn scary all of a sudden too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That really surprised me back then.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: When you were talking about your father, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I was just angry that he seemed to be mocking our music, that's all.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Akito's serious about his music, so he can't help but feel strongly when someone tries to belittle it.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (If I told him he really saved me when he got angry on my behalf that day, he'd probably say I was being dramatic...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What're you thinking about this time?
If you have something to say, just say it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, I wasn't trying to say anything.
I was just lost in thought...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You, on the other hand, should really let your emotions show on your face more often.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sometimes I just don't understand what's on your mind.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes... I get that comment a lot.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Personally, I think I express my joy and anger quite normally, though...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, it's just a matter of getting used to it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Let's try something... Give me an angry face.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay... How about this?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That doesn't look anything like an angry face. Okay, next. Give me a smile.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right... Like this?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's not very different than before.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You don't have to apologize for anything...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, your expressions are so natural when you're singing. Why's it so hard for you to do the same in your daily life?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was hoping to become better at that by learning from you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Except your scary face.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Don't worry. No matter what scary thing you're thinking of, I highly doubt it'll ever show on that poker face of yours.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That can't be true.
I may...smirk. I guess.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sure, that'll be the day.
Anyway, let's get back to talking about our next show.
Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sigh... I'm dying from hunger here.
Toya, let's go to the school store.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Sorry, Akito.
Can you wait for just a little longer?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure, but...why?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I need to talk to someone.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, if it isn't Toya!
What's the matter? Do you need something from me?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Well, I just wanted to say thank you...
Thank you for your help that day.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, you mean that time when you were standing around all spaced out? I didn't do anything much, though.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I just thought I had to thank you anyway...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What happened between you guys?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, Akito's here too?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As a matter of fact, I resolved your partner's distress just the other day in the most glorious way! Ha ha ha ha!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Of course you did. How could I have ever guessed? By the way, Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? What is it?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: There's a bug on your shoulder. Big one.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wha?! A bug?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Uh oh. It just went inside your clothes because you moved...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tsukasa, I saw the bug flying off somewhere just now. You're fine.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff... So it's not here anymore?
Thank the stars...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Aww, I'm so happy for you, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Cut it out...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Anyway, once again, thank you, Tsukasa.
You really did save me back then.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's all I wanted to say.
Well, we have to go now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, wait! I just remembered!
Let me see... They should be in this pocket...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Found them! Here.
You guys can have these tickets.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What are these?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Entry tickets to Phoenix Wonderland! I'll be performing a new show there soon, so use them to come behold my most majestic presence on stage!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I appreciate this gesture, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Come on, two high school boys going to a theme park together by themselves? You've gotta be kidding me...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: True... Just the two of you does seem a little lonely.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So you can have these tickets bac—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Very well! I cannot ignore such a reasonable request from the friend of Toya, an honorary member of my fan club!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Two more tickets specially for you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now you can ask more friends to join you and dispel that fog of solitude from your outing! Just be sure to be there! Hahahaha!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ah, wait... Hey!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He's gone... And I didn't even ask for more tickets. Toya, what are you gonna do about these—

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Tsukasa's performance...
What's it going to be like?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (H-He's really keen about this...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'm aware they've known each other for a really long time, but why is Toya so attached to him?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Did something happen between them in the past?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, are you listening?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, sorry.
I wasn't listening.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I asked you if you wanted to give the two remaining tickets to Azusawa and Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa... Wouldn't that make them think we're inviting them to come along with us?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's fine by me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I did make them worry about me, so this will be a good way for me to make amends.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sigh... Yeah, I guess we can't keep owing them favors. We'll ask them the next time we visit the shop.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, let's do that. It's already quite late.
We should head for the school store before all the food gets sold out.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No thanks to you approaching that guy to talk!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Don't call him that. His name is Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Fine, fine!
C'mon, let's go already!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Didn't get to ask what happened between them in the end.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I guess I'll just have to save that for next time.)
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane and I are this way, so we'll see you later!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. See ya.
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Seems like Azusawa and Shiraishi are back to normal.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It looks like your talk with Shiraishi really had an effect on her.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Maybe. Anyway, I knew those two were strong enough to weather this storm.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: True. I guess we didn't need to worry much.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, I wouldn't band together with someone I didn't believe in.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: An's got her eyes on outdoing RAD WEEKEND, and she's smart enough to understand how important partners are for that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To put on an event like that, your team has to fit together seamlessly and run like clockwork.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I guess that's why she was searching for someone to team up with for so long.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But it was a surprise that she'd pick someone like Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's her choice, and I get that she wants to take care of her now that they've done some stuff together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well, if you believed in them that much, you could've given her the news a little differently...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What do you mean? I said things as clearly as I could.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I guess...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito... Do you think something like this happened to us too?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I just thought that maybe you understood Shiraishi's feelings right away because you've experienced that yourself.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
As in...
If I tried to protect you or something?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Don't be dumb, I never did.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (As if Toya ever needed me to take him under my wing...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I approached him out of curiosity because I thought he sounded pretty good...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Then I found out he wasn't just good. He was a natural with a musical background and intuition way out of my league.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I couldn't have hoped for a better partner for trying to realize my goals.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But I had to step up my game to keep up with him, so I practiced like it was nobody's business.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I couldn't let the fact that I wasn't as talented stop me...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, it's nothing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we gotta figure out what we're gonna do until the outdoor gig...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A month can go by really fast.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. We can't let a single day go to waste.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How about we check out the event schedule at a few clubs before we head home?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yeah. Sounds good.
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, it's Akito and Toya!
Are you going to MEIKO's cafe?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nah, we've got a gig tonight, so we came over to kill some time and rehearse.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I was just about to start practice too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I know a good place. Want to come along?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure, why not. Where is it?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's my special secret spot for practicing! I normally keep it to myself, but I don't mind showing you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Fine, I'll bite.
Toya, you okay with going with Len?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yeah, sure...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Alright!
Follow me!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: By the way, isn't there something you want to tell me?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Tell you about what...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You know, isn't there something on your mind?
Something you want to talk about?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, not really...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, stop beating around the bush and just tell us.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, come on! I mean Kohane and An, obviously!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, that.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You can always talk to me when you're having problems with your partners!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
You wanted us to do that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I knew that they'd sort things out by themselves, so I wasn't really worried.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm. Really?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You know, Miku said almost the exact same thing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Really? What did she say?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
“They'll sort it out between themselves.”
She pretended not to notice what was going on.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I think that part of her is really cool.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I'm not like that. If someone's having a rough time, I want to lend them a hand.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We're the same then...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
My friends are always helping me out.
I really want to do something for them too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, that's exactly how I feel.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I owe Akito the most, so I'm always thinking of ways to help or support him...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But he's got it all together, so I never get any opportunities to do that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: On one hand, it's great that he's so independent, but a little frustrating at the same time.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm, I think I see what you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya, you really didn't know...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I rely on you a lot.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You do...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure. There were a lot of things I couldn't do before we teamed up.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: When I was by myself, I just glossed over so many things and tried to just force my way over each hurdle.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But your musical talent made me realize that it wasn't good enough.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
So I did help you improve in some way.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If you didn't, we wouldn't still be partners.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I noticed this about you too, Akito...
You're surprisingly frank or earnest sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What are you talking about?
I'm just speaking my mind.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Anyway, we've been walking a while.
We not there yet? How much longer is it?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh no! We already passed it by!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Dude...
Get it together...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm really sorry! You've got a gig tonight and I ended up wasting your time... Let's backtrack a bit!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
There's no rush.
We still have plenty of time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's no big deal.
We can stick around a while longer.
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Hey, Akito.
Just you today?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, just dropping by on the way to work.
Can I get the usual blend?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You got it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But if this drags on,
I'll just cause problems for our group.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So I've decided that I'm going to talk to him today...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He has to sort out his issues with his dad by himself...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (So I really should just be patient and give him space but...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I wonder if he actually did manage to talk to his dad...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Based on what Toya said himself,
his old man's as stubborn they get.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But at the same time, the apple doesn't fall far from the tree, I guess...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Why the cranky look?
And here's your coffee.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, also...
Want some free cookies to go with it?
They're pretty good.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No, thanks.
That's more up Toya or Kohane's alley.
I'm not a little kid that gets lured in by sweets.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hahaha. Suit yourself.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: So why is my very grown-up customer sighing and scowling this much today?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I'm guessing you're worried about Toya, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sigh... If only our dads were like you, Ken.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hmm? I know about Toya's father, but you too...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Is yours another difficult one too?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, you could say that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I've told you about my older sister, right?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Yeah, you keep complaining about her.
Something about being her personal servant?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Ah, I see...
Do your father and sister not get along?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
That'd be a huge understatement.
My sister, Ena, can't stand our dad.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She used to flip out when she was in junior high anytime he saw his face, and took it out on me sometimes too...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Seriously, why do I have to get all caught up in her issues?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Back then, the only way I could think of calming her down was to run out to the store and get her ice cream or something, and now she's gotten too used to it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She's shrewd like that, but she goes berserk if something starts bothering her. Luckily, I don't have to worry about her now like I did before...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She rebelled against dad and still does it through her art.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, Toya should just stop listening to what his dad has to say...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I understand how you feel, but it may not be so easy for Toya.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: His dad's been drilling classical music into him since he was little and he obediently did as he was told to this point.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: It's so ingrained in him that he can't just separate himself from his father. Just like how an apple doesn't fall far from the tree.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess you're right...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I wish I could do something to help him get over it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, what are you doing?
You're messing up my hair!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hahaha! That'll suit you better.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, it won't. Sheesh...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Just let Toya deal with his dilemmas at his own pace for now. There's no need to obsess over it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I wasn't obsessing...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Then it's all good. Just keep doing what you've been doing: singing together with Toya.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: That's what he needs the most, I think.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Ken...
Yeah, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Besides, I decided to step back and let Toya do what he's gotta do.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks for your insight, Ken.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Don't worry about it.
I'm expecting great things from you guys.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: On a different topic, how's your job? Are you being a good, diligent employee?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Believe it or not, I've never missed a day of work or slacked off once...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hahaha. I know, I know...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sheesh.
Anyway, I've gotta go...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Have a good one.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, time to go...!
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, you wanna go to MEIKO's then?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sure... Hm? The Open sign's not up?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Huh. But the lights are on.
Let's go take a look.
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(The music's different from usual...
This is a classical piece...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, Akito, Toya!
Welcome!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You came just at the right time.
Would you like to join our listening party?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Listening party...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Heya, Toya!
Long time no see!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It has been a while.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Since when exactly...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Since the last time Toya came. He brought this CD and we all listened to it together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Solo Piano Performance by Harumichi Aoyagi... Wait a second!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it's a recording of my dad's concert.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The day after the event, we didn't have practice and had nothing to do.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I found it while I was looking through my CD collection. I brought it here and listened to it together with MEIKO, Rin and Len.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He used to wince whenever someone even hinted at classical music until just recently...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But I guess he's really over that all now.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Since you're here, why not stay and have a listen?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure, sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But it feels kind of strange.
You played jazz in the background sometimes,
but never classical...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're right. Part of the reason I was able to appreciate this CD may've been this cafe's peaceful atmosphere.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it does feel like you're at home here...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, another piece just started!
Hm... What's this one called?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait... I've heard this one somewhere before...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's a suite by Modest Mussorgsky called Pictures at an Exhibition.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right, we listened to it in music class. We watched a video of it being performed by an orchestra too, I think...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You think?
Sounds like you weren't paying attention...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I gave that thing five whole minutes...
But that was my limit...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Still, I don't blame you. The videos they show in class are pretty low quality and don't do orchestras, or anything for that matter, much justice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Besides, this suite was written for the piano, not for an orchestra.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, really...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's being played by just one guy on one instrument, but it has richness and an intensity to it. I'm getting goosebumps...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(You can tell he's a world-class pianist...
Man, Toya's dad's a legit pro.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? What is it, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Just realizing that you've been exposed to next-level music ever since you were a little kid...
Or maybe even since you were a baby.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's no wonder your ears are this good.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I guess I should thank my dad for that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Since Toya stopped stressing about his dad, we're all performing better and really getting to polish our music.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (If we keep this up, we're gonna go places...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You look like you're in a good mood.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Not just in a good mood. I feel driven.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Toya really went through a growth spurt after what he dealt with...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (As his partner, I can't fall behind!)
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Akito, welcome!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just you? Where's Toya?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, I'm meeting with Toya later at Weekend Garage.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, but you came here anyway...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes, or it did I guess...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I'm sorry.
I was being an idiot...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I already apologized to Toya and the others about that...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...
Even so, you don't look too great.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Because there's still one person left I need to apologize to.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh? Who's that?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ken...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Akito, aren't you pushing yourself a little too hard...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You're all about giving it everything you have while making sure that you don't waste any time or energy, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks for the advice, but...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's just not enough.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And in the end, I lost to Tono again and made my friend come help pick up the pieces afterwards...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. Is that why you've been feeling uneasy around them?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... But based on what I've heard from everyone, Ken isn't the kind of person that gets bothered by stuff like that...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: However, I understand your situation. Just take your time and relax a while here until you're ready...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
And here's your usual blend.
Oh, also...! Would you like to try some honey instead of sugar today?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Honey?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You seem pretty tired, so I thought something more nutritious might help.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're right. Sure, I'll take some...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay. Just give me a second.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO, can you put that song on too while you're at it? Akito still probably hasn't heard it yet.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, right! That song!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That song?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's a DJ mix that we recorded.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: DJ? You mean Len and...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Whoa! It grabs your attention right from the start...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's put together pretty well too... It sort of feels fun and playful too for some reason...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Did Len do this part? No, this doesn’t sound like anything I've heard him play...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (So that means it has to be...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Um, so who helped make this mix...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, that would be KAITO.
Speaking of which...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hello, MEIKO...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, KAITO. Welcome.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, Akito! It's been a while!
How have you been?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey. Yeah, I've been good...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Really? Your friends seemed to be very worried about you...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We've already dealt with that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You have? That's great!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In that case, MEIKO, can I have an orange juice and a melon soda?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wait, both?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Could it be that you're trying to show off by treating Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Me? I already have my coffee though...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, no. These are just for me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, an orange juice and melon soda it is then.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, Miku...
Is KAITO always like this...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Like this...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You know, like he always has his head in the clouds or something...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I'd say this is normal.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Does that bother you, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, not really. At least, I don't think so...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's just that it feels so different from what I heard in that mix a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I understand. Music can act as a reflection of someone's heart or personality.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Someone's heart?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, like their love of music or even their commitment to it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There certainly is that side to him where he seems aloof and goes around eating Len's ice cream...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But he's also Len's teacher as a DJ and knows exactly what kind of music he wants to make.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
He knows what he wants...
I definitely get that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: *Sigh*... All these people that are way too good are popping up left and right...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. But when you get a chance, I hope you'll talk to him. I'm sure you'll enjoy it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, when I do get a chance...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line: K-KAITO?! What are you doing?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I thought mixing my orange juice and melon soda together would be good.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm glad you didn't make a mess or anything, but what's a grown man doing something like that for?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: My apologies! It's just my natural desire to mix things up, I suppose.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's all a part of being a DJ. Haha.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That part I'll never understand...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, I think you're better off not trying to...
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's been a while since I've been by this place thanks to what happened...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But I have to do this. We need to talk about what we're gonna do moving forward so...)
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hey, Akito. Long time no see.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Here, have a seat.
What'll it be? Your usual blend?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Uh, yes... Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'll start by saying I'm sorry for not taking his warning seriously...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Also, Akito...
Would you like a dollop of cream with your coffee?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Think of it as a treat for being one of my regulars.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, also...! Would you like to try some honey instead of sugar today?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (First MEIKO, now Ken...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Are you trying to get me to eat something sweet so that I'll start feeling better...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hahaha! You got me!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I appreciate the thought, but I'll pass...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ken...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yes...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm sorry about ignoring what you said even though I knew you were worried about me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: After that Tono guy said that we wouldn't be able to surpass RAD WEEKEND, I challenged him and lost even though I gave it everything I had...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I ran off and tried to do everything on my own...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I really don't think you need to apologize or anything...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Honestly, I was sort of happy to see you acting more like a normal kid.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean by that?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: From time to time, you guys always try to be act more grown up than you really are.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Like that time Toya was having issues with his father.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That wasn't really the plan, but I mean, we're in high school so we're a little more grown up than...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, come on.
High schoolers are still kids in most people's eyes.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
That includes me.
Do you know how many times my partner and I fought back then?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You fighting, Ken?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yeah. Back then, compared to me, you would've looked like an honor student.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: RAD WEEKEND, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Oh, I think I'm just happy that there are youngsters out there, like you and Arata, that made that even a part of their goal in life.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: But you also shouldn't lock yourself into just that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Goals and ideals are things that can give people purpose, but also mislead them.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: A lot of people end up seeing the past, their own pasts especially, through rose-colored glasses.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Without even realizing it, we all sort of exaggerate the truth and detach ourselves from reality.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm not sure what you're trying to say.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll understand in time...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: For now, just make sure to cherish your friends. They seemed very worried about you over what happened.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right. I've already learned my lesson.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But what did you mean by truth and reality just now?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, that?
If you're so grown up, you should be able to find the answer.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What?! You were the one that said I was still a kid!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hahaha. Did I?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're pulling my leg...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, relax.
Let me get you a nice, big dollop for your coffee too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You are messing with me!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: So that's a no?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Ugh...
Fine, I'll take some...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Dad, I have a little time, so I'll help out until everyone else get here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, A-Akito...?
You're already here?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, yeah...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
On second thought, Ken...
I'll pass on that topping.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Sorry, the order's already in.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Hey, An. Can you get this?
A dollop of cream for his coffee!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A dollop of cream?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What are you looking at...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, nothing. Would you like a little extra as a freebie?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, you're the same as him!
Wedding Ceremony Hall

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
One, two, three, four...
Take each step like you mean it and exaggerate your arm movements a little more...!

rows.Speaker: Extra A
rows.Line: I did it...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, that should pretty much do it then.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We can move on to rehearsing the whole thing, but let's take a quick break before we do.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (*Sigh*... The dance team looks like it's gonna be fine...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(That just leaves the other guys...
I think I'll go see how Toya's doing...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, you on break too?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, we're waiting for Kamishiro to get here before we start our last rehearsal for the proposal scene.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You guys gonna be alright...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm talking about the other guys. The dude that plays basketball or the one that's good at origami, you know? I don't get what the plan is...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Ah, I see.
But I'm sure Kamishiro has thought all of that out already.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's exactly why I'm asking if it's gonna be alright.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I think so. It seems he's even talked to the bride about what she and her fiancé are like.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He made his decision based on that information, so I believe things will go just fine.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It just looked like from my perspective that he was trying to mess with people and have a laugh over it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Kamishiro did seem a little off at first and I wouldn't blame anyone for thinking so...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But he made this decision believing that this surprise will succeed and make everyone smile in the end.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He even carefully observed his surroundings and came up with what he thought was necessary.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm starting to feel that Kamishiro is no different from Tsukasa in that regard.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's he got to do with this...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (They're the same...? They're both weirdos, so I guess they kind of are...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you for waiting...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, Shinonome.
How is the dance team coming along?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: All good. At the very least, the other teams shouldn't be disappointed with where we're at.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, shall we begin the final rehearsal for the proposal scene?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Kamishiro...
Mind if I watch for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Be my guest.
Since you're here, would you like to play the bride just for now?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, this is good.
We'll go with this, so please try to maintain this level for the ceremony.

rows.Speaker: Toya & Extras
rows.Line: We will!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nice work. Looks like you're all set to go now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I feel relieved too.
So how did everything look?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I thought it was good.
I don't know anything about acting, but the atmosphere felt right.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay... I think it's all thanks to Kamishiro's advice...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: His advice?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
Then let's imagine the thing you desire the most is sitting right in front of you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But that very thing is about to be taken away from you by someone else.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And there's only one way for you to take it back, which is to sing for it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sing for it, huh...?
He actually said that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, he did. Then what we're trying to achieve popped right into my head.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Exactly. We also have to keep singing to make that actually happen...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, did you talk to Kamishiro at all outside of the School Festival...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh? I saw him a few times in the library, but today's the first time that I've had a real conversation with him.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay then...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Kamishiro did seem a little off at first and I wouldn't blame anyone for thinking so...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But he made this decision believing that this surprise will succeed and make everyone smile in the end.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He even carefully observed his surroundings and came up with what he thought was necessary.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Observing your surroundings and coming up with what's needed, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (When he invited me to help out, he didn't just politely ask... He goaded me into it...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Yeah, he's definitely good at figuring out what people are really like...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I also feel dumb for not seeing that sooner. Ugh...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But he wants this surprise show to succeed too.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I can trust him there at least.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shinonome, do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Would it be okay if I observed the dance team go through their final rehearsal?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You're the director, right?
Why are you even asking?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Then I'll be looking forward to it.
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, hi there.
Are you done with practice?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. Something to drink would be nice too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sure thing. Your usual café au lait sound good? Everyone else, please feel free to order...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then I'd like my usual too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm getting kinda hungry. Maybe I'll get something to eat...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In that case, I have something special ready just for you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Something special?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes! Pancakes with extra whipped cream!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, that!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (The one I didn't get to eat the other day!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You just added that to the menu, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I remember now!
I saw it last time and was wondering what it'd be like!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too...! But if I eat all that now, I'll be too full for dinner...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Then let's split one, Kohane!
Mind if we do that, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You got it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, MEIKO!
And you too, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What about you, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm having one too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You really like pancakes, don't you, Akito?
Are you not having any, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, I'm not much of a sweets person.
Coffee is more than enough for me.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, coming right up!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
And here you are...
Pancakes with extra whipped cream!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wow, this looks amazing...!
There's so much whipped cream!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I knew it'd be big, but this thing's enormous!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It said extra, right? This looks about right to me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, you sure seem to know your way around. Could it be that you go to cafes like these pretty often?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Leave it, okay? Let's just eat.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Heh... Actually, we stopped by a place like this after practice yesterday as part of our deal for that show we did.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Toya...
You don't have to tell them everything...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That may be true, but Shiraishi did help us out in the end. Since we're on the topic, I still need to pay you back for doing that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me? Then I'll try to think of something.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An, I split it in half. Wanna get started?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks, Kohane!
Let's dig in!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh... It's so good!
My mouth is literally in heaven!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You're right! This whipped cream is so light and fluffy too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I didn't know Akito made that sort of face too when he's eating something he really likes.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh...?! What are you talking about...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Oh, nothing...
But why do you like pancakes so much?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why? I don't really have a reason. I've just been eating them for a long time.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: A long time?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. On weekends during elementary school, we always had hotcakes for breakfast.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: My mom really likes fluffy cakes too, like castella and souffles.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Doesn't your sister like pancakes too, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, she does. We have the same dislikes too... Come to think of it, our whole family's kinda the same...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Having the same likes and dislikes seems nice.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What about you, Toya?
Why do you like coffee so much?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No reason in particular, but if anything, it might be because Ken makes good coffee...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The coffee he makes has a sort of soothing effect.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Really?
Is there anything you've liked since you were little...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Cookies, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, why's that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My mother doesn't cook very often, but during special occasions, like my birthday, she'll bake cookies for us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? Cookies instead of cake?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I don't actually know why, but my father and brothers also just seemed to believe it's what our family does...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I knew they were only for special occasions, but before I realized it, I was asking her to make them whenever. I just seemed to fall in love with them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I get where you're coming from!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: My mom isn't great at cooking either, but never stopped talking about how good she was at making rum raisins!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: When I was little, we'd have rum raisin ice cream and I always thought it was a really grown up thing to do. It felt like a really special feast back then!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. So that's why you like rum raisin ice cream so much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah! How about you, Kohane?
You really like peaches, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. That actually has nothing to do with how they taste. I started liking them because I thought they looked really cute.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I didn't know that!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Looks like everyone's enjoying themselves...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To be fair, anyone can go on and on about the things they like.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I suppose you're right...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: About those cookies you were talking about. Does your mom still make them?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? Yes, she does.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Then why don't you ask her sometime?
“Why cookies of all things?”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm sure it'll be easier to ask compared to before, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I mean, he's on better terms with his family now so...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, okay...
I'll try asking her.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Cool.
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's try it once from the top...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna watch!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sure.
Ready, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
That was so cool!
You guys looked really solid the whole way through!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks, but we still have to hammer out the details for some of these other parts.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And once our performance comes together, I'm sure your friend will appreciate it very much.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You mean Akito's old classmate from elementary school?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I believe they also played together on the same soccer team.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Akito in elementary school, huh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, Akito! What were you like back then? You don't have to stop taking your break, but I'm really curious!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What was I like...?
I doubt you'll find it very interesting.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
That's totally fine.
I just wanna learn more about you guys!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd like to as well.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've hardly ever heard you talk about yourself from that far back.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, I don't mind talking about it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So to put it simply, I guess I was pretty cocky...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hm? How's that different from now?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, do you want me to talk or not?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Eep! Sorry!
That was meant to be a joke!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'll stop, I promise. Please, continue...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And you say that you were cocky, but I suspect that there's more to this.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, or maybe... How or why were you like that?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I've liked playing sports for as long as I can remember, and my teachers back then recommended that I play for clubs and stuff. But I kept refusing to for a while...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really? I would've thought you wanted to play for teams like that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I tried joining this baseball team once and kept getting into arguments with the team's ace, who was already there and a lot older than me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The same thing happened for basketball. I'd usually have no problem picking up a new sport.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Looking back, it never felt like I had ever accomplished anything.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But when I was a kid, I'd always say stuff like, That's it? This is easy!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So another way to put it is, you were very athletic...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. That part of you really hasn't changed at all, huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: True. And out of all the sports, I did try, I stuck with soccer the longest...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It was rough at first because the pitch was huge. I had to think about where everybody was positioned, and it felt like way too much for me to remember.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But whenever we gelled as a team, it felt like a lot of fun. That was probably why I stuck with it for so long.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And... Somewhere along the way, I'd convinced myself that I was taking it seriously.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Convinced yourself...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I didn't understand what it meant to be good or what losing when it mattered really felt like.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, during my last match as a sixth-grader, the favorites, to win this one tournament, clobbered us...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That team was apparently full of kids that left home just to go play soccer and train to become pros.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What?! But they were just elementary schoolers, right...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I froze after I heard that too. I had no idea whatsoever.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I asked myself if I could commit like that too and I just couldn't find an answer.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I felt like an idiot for thinking I was so good and not understanding what it meant to take the sport seriously, so I quit.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But you're helping the soccer club even now, no? Is that...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, that? They were talking about doing scrims but just barely didn't have enough for two teams, so I ended up joining them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I get what it's like to want to practice as much as you can to find ways to win.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So I'd feel like the bad guy if I sort of became the reason they couldn't do that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And in the end, you know what?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess I just like playing soccer.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I still haven't forgotten how I felt back then, but now, just kicking around a ball helps me push that away...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That makes me pretty lame, huh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really? I think that's a good thing.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I mean, it'd be awful not to be able to do something that you really like doing, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You really know which buttons to press sometimes, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, hey, Akito!
I kinda feel like playing soccer now. You think we can do it here?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hm? Maybe...
We can try juggling a ball or something.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Juggling, sure!
Just keep the ball in the air for as long as I can, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's do that!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We still have dance practice, you know?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
That's that! This is this!
It can be just during our break, so please, teach me!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Throw him a bone, Akito.
He's already helped us out this much.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Lately, it feels like we've been giving more than receiving...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Okay, fine.
I'll bring a ball next time.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yay!
Promise, okay? If you don't and forget like KAITO always does, I'm gonna be mad.

rows.Line: Oh, they also said something about it being “explosive”...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?! K-Kohane, give that thing back to Akito right now!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Sure, but I really don't think it's supposed to be that dangerous...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I thought the same.
Kamishiro always puts making others smile a priority so...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Making others smile, huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, wanna try opening it...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, are you sure?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Not opening it is just gonna make us feel worse, so if you guys are all okay with it, we can try opening it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Toya
rows.Line:
Okay!
Sure.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Here goes nothing...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What the...?!
The lid was rigged with party poppers...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa-In-The-Box
rows.Line:
Happy birthday!
Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What is this thing...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
A jack-in-the-box, I suppose...
So the box was designed to set off these poppers and release this Tsukasa doll as you opened it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's so cute!
And it's wishing you a happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yeah, I can see that... I also saw something else fly out when I opened this thing...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You mean this? I see one, two, three... Four bags! There's something in all of them too...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hold on, I see names written on them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, you're right! This one's for Toya... This one's for Kohane... This one's mine, and here's yours, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It may be fun to wait and open it with your friends later.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (So that's what he meant.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, those seem to be your guys', so they're yours now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Really? Thank you, Shinonome!
Hehe. I wonder what's inside?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's take a look!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay! Oh, some snacks!
Does that mean we're supposed to share these?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I believe so.
Ours is filled with snacks as well.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: See? It wasn't anything dangerous.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. It ended up being a regular present, except...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa-In-The-Box
rows.Line:
Happy birthday!
Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What do we do with this thing?
Shinonome Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm home.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, there you are.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Just so you know. I've been waiting to have cheesecake because you took your sweet time getting home.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Didn't I say that I'd be late?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Welcome home, Akito.
We were just about to start getting everything ready. What color candles would you like?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Candles...?
I'm not a little kid anymore, Mom.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, that's too bad.
I guess I can save them for Ena and your father.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, Mom, you're not serious, right?! I don't mind candles, but not on a cake or anything, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Ena's Voice
rows.Line: I mean, how would you feel if you were served cheesecake that was covered in holes?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Is that all you care about?

rows.Speaker: Mother's Voice
rows.Line: Anyway, Akito, it's time for dinner so go get changed!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, okay.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (All things considered, another pretty good birthday...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Akito.
It's nice to see you after so long. We should chat again sometime, and feel free to complain about Ena all you want, alright?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi told me that it's your birthday today, Akito. Happy birthday! Hehe. I know what it's like to have a sibling, so let's both do our best to stay close with them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nooo! Why didn't Ena tell me that it's your birthday sooner?! Anyway, Li'l Bro, happy birthday! I'll get you lunch next time we meet at school♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Akito.
I found an outfit that might suit you when I was out shopping with Airi the other day, so I'll need you to try it on later.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Did you enjoy my little surprise, Shinonome? By the way, the Tsukasa-In-The-Box will stop talking if you take it off of its spring... Feel free to do whatever you like with it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Akito!
I'm not too worried about you not doing this, but be sure to cherish your friends and share the snacks with one another!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Your stoic personality's already given me so much courage, Shinonome. Hehe. I'm really looking forward to seeing what the future has in store for us!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks for being such a great teammate and source of advice when it comes to having a partner. I'll be counting on you moving forward!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Akito. I promise to pay you back for everything you've done for me, so please, promise to ask me for help whenever you need it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks for celebrating my birthday like this today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Outside of my family and everyone at school, Toya and Ken are the only ones who'd wish me a happy birthday until just recently...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But making a big fuss about it with a bunch of friends is kinda fun.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm gonna spend this year doing everything I can to surpass “RAD WEEKEND”...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I know it won't be easy, but I'm not letting anyone take my dream away from me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And don't forget to drop by to check us out.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: See you then.
Aboard a train

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Having time to relax is great and all, but I think I'm starting to get bored...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well, in that case, there's something I'd like to ask you... That is, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ask me what?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You mentioned how you and your family have been to this campground before, yes?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Would you mind telling me more about what you did that time? I'd like to get a preview of where we're going if possible.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A preview...? Yeah, that makes sense knowing you...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna hear too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, settle down.
I will since we have time to kill.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I remember the time we went camping when I was in sixth grade the best. We went during spring break after my dad suddenly decided to take us on a trip...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? Not during summer?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, according to him, it gets too crowded because of all the tourists.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We went for three days and two nights that time...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We started by pitching a tent together... After that, we played around until it was time to eat.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, by we I mean, Ena, my mom and myself.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, what about your dad?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, he was there to paint the mountains, the scenery and us running around...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He even drew pictures of us while we went fishing down by this river that was nearby.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
To be fair, he's a professional artist.
I'm guessing that he was looking for some sort of inspiration for his work.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Who knows? Oh, but Ena did throw him into the river for not giving her enough attention.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I can sympathize with her there. You were there as a family, so it's normal to want to spend time together.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. By the way, did you manage to catch any fish?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Not even a nibble.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The worst part was how I could see them in the water. After a while, I thought that it'd be faster to just use my hands to catch them, but that didn't work either...

rows.Speaker: Toya
