rows.Line: I can see that look of frustration on you now. Do you remember doing anything else?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We smashed watermelons...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You did? By a river?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, there's no rule saying that you have to smash them at the beach.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! You can dunk them in the river to get them all nice and cold!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see... So it's a different way of enjoying the same activity.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yup.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Also, I guess that was the last time we went camping as a family...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, I was just trying to remember what else we did that time...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, that was probably the most fun I had while camping.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Did it help?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, it did.
The part about smashing watermelons by a river was very interesting.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's what drew your attention?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You used to go camping a lot too, right, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Not as much as you think since we had to keep the cafe going.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I do remember going fishing and stuff whenever we did go. My dad actually likes to fish as a hobby.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ken fishes?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! You won't see it on our menu or anything, but he'll prep and cook the fish he catches for us from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: From scratch? Seriously?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know, right? I can remove the innards and stuff, but don't really know how to cook a fish besides grilling it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, that can wait until next time! Our main goal right now is to go check out a forest!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Next time? Our current trip's hardly started yet.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. But it might be fun to go fishing with you guys. Who do you think would get the first catch?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, it's a sport that rewards patience, so my bet's on Toya or Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, I get that you wouldn't have any luck, but what are you throwing me under the bus for?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because you're the kind of person who thinks about jumping into a river to catch fish instead of using a rod.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's ancient history!

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ugh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm really looking forward to this trip.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, so am I...
Campground

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We'll be over there brushing our teeth...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay. It's dark, so please watch your step.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Someone's in a good mood...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (This happened during the Summer Festival too. He'll be all giddy and anxious but not really show it...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Is he gonna be able to sleep tonight...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Anyway, Akito, we should also start getting ready for bed.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Yeah, my guess is no...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't think you've realized it yet, but you seem way too excited about all this...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You sure you'll be able to get any sleep?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, you might be right...
This may prove challenging.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I knew it...
I mean, why now? There's nothing left for us to do except sleep at this point.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We may be in a tent, but we're sleeping outdoors and I've never done that before. My mind may be focusing on that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I get that...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I know how he feels, but still...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (No, we did a lot today. He might be more tired than I realize. Maybe he'll end up falling asleep right away...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We're back.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, you two about to call it a night?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, about that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We were just talking while brushing our teeth and can't seem to get our minds to settle down.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Neither of us has slept in a tent like this for so long.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess we're just excited about that, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You too, huh...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, does that mean you guys...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, just Toya.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That still works.
We were just talking about warming up some milk before the embers go out.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: How about it, you guys?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sure, sounds good.
How about you, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like some as well.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Awesome!
Oh, I think some molten chocolate is in order as well.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Just after brushing your teeth?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'll just brush them again!
C'mon, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh wow, the milk's starting to smell really sweet...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
That should do it...
Careful, it's pretty hot.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...
This is delicious.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, it's hot but really soothing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: How hot is it?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Really? How old's that joke?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's up, Toya...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I thought I heard some bugs just now...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I can hear them too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too... It's really just our voices and the sounds of the natural world now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. It's so calm and peaceful.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Looks like Toya's pretty much back to being himself too...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's put this fire out and get some sleep...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay. *Yawn*... I'll probably be out before I know it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is it okay for us to put it out with water? It might smoke up a lot...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Is it bad if that happens?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, so our enemies don't find us?
I've seen that in books and movies.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, you're supposed to cover it in dirt or sand to prevent that from happening.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What enemies exactly...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, um... Sorry.
Camping just sort of reminded me of that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
All good, girl.
It's too dark to see smoke, so we should be fine.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Look, no one's out to get us.
Let's put this out already.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay.
Night, Shiraishi, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Night.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Good night, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Night. Try not to oversleep, okay?
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Miku and Len seemed so happy about getting to see where RAD WEEKEND happened.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, Len was practically bouncing off the walls.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Do you know when we'll get to go, Kohane? Did Uncle Taiga mention any details?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, he said he'd get back to me soon...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So I promise to let you guys know when I do hear from him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, let's call it a day.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, see you guys tomorrow!
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I hope we hear from Taiga soon.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Same.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, to think I'm gonna get to see COL again...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Why are you looking at me like that...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's just, I've already heard all that before in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You have?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's clear that this place means a lot to you personally on top of being where our dream was born.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, true.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I had a lot on my mind back then too...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: On my way home that night, I told myself, “I'm gonna put on an event like that someday... At COL!”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, something along the lines of wanting to perform in an event alongside Ken and everyone else.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That was when I decided to start learning how to sing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I even started going to live houses every day to hear what they were singing, and I'd practice singing those same songs at home...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But Ken retired before I got a chance to actually enter into an event, and COL shut its doors for good.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I didn't know what to do with myself at first, but my goal of surpassing that night never dimmed.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If anything, those things that happened made me even more determined...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Which is why I can't believe I get to go back to that place.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa, hold on... Deja vu...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you, Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Why are you thanking me?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Because you were willing to tell me more about just how important this dream is to you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
It's not gonna be easy...
I mean, impossible might not even cut it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Nothing's carved in stone yet.
Also, I'm sure Taiga will be there with us when we're at COL.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, true.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, this is bad...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Why?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Because... I feel way too giddy right now...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This live house means a lot to me, but I've got my head in the clouds...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You think so?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I believe having someone or something to look up to is very important. The same goes for having a dream.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sure you know that best, Akito, based on what you're trying to achieve.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You said that most, if not all, of the musicians on Vivid Street laughed at your proclamation.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And yet, you stuck with it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's why I'd like it if you could look at this as a reward for all your hard work, and just simply enjoy it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What, like some kind of party?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Why not?
By doing so, you might even surprise Azusawa and Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Surprise them? I'll probably just creep them out.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still... Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If you think it's okay, then I'll enjoy the moment for a little bit longer.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Good.
I'll be looking forward to seeing that side of you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What? Why you...!
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hi, Shinonome!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Over here!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Be right there.
Weekend Garage Stage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We're figuring out the set list for our next event, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, let's get that out of the way so we can get to practicing!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You two seem way too excited...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well, we've had an interesting couple of days.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So this is where RAD WEEKEND happened...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's so much smaller than I remember.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Probably because we were kids.
I'm guessing we were both a lot shorter back then.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. That means we've grown up a lot since.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, the stage is literally right in front of us...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: It's about time you guys saw this.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: It's a video of RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: So, what did you think of RAD WEEKEND?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Think you can surpass it...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I can't say for sure...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It exceeded all of my expectations...
I sort of can't believe something like this actually happened...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's... Scary...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I feel more excited about this than before.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I feel even more determined to surpass RAD WEEKEND now. So...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We will... We absolutely will!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess just that day alone was pretty jam-packed...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Exactly.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not only did we get to visit where you and Shiraishi had gone all those years ago, we got to see a video of what happened.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But it wasn't just us.
Mita, Tono and even his partner...
They were all there too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm pretty sure all the other teams we've been running into were there as well.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's on top of our local music lovers!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: All true.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Come to think of it, that was also when I first met that one guy.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (So many people. I can't see the stage at all.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (Most of these people are probably regulars here, so I won't be able to just push my way through them. I'll just listen here and...)

rows.Speaker: Man
rows.Line: Hey, you!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Huh? A-Are you talking to me...?

rows.Speaker: Man
rows.Line:
Yeah, you!
Don't be a wallflower! Get in the middle!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: But I...

rows.Speaker: Man
rows.Line: This might be a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, kid! We're probably never gonna see a lineup like this again!

rows.Speaker: Man
rows.Line: You had the guts to come here, so you should try to get the most out of this chance!

rows.Speaker: Man
rows.Line: Don't worry, we're all here to have fun and see what unfolds!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
In that case...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That really happened...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That was so nice of him.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, he's sort of the reason why I was able to get into music. He showed me how fun it could be.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And he hasn't changed one bit.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You mean now?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You've met him before.
He's the manager where I work.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're totally right!
He's like the definition of a music connoisseur!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I've even heard that he wanted to open a shop on Vivid Street just so he can go to live houses every day.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Does that mean you started working for him because of this encounter you had?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, that was just a coincidence.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I went around Vivid Street to see if there was anything good since it was close to the park where we practice...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That was when I stumbled upon this boutique shop. It was only when I went in to take a look that I found out he's the manager.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He vaguely remembered who I was, patted me on the back and said, “Look at you! All grown up!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! He sounds like your uncle, not your manager!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I know, right? He was just looking to hire someone, so I decided to work there.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Not only that, he didn't laugh at my dream.)

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: You're gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: That's great! I've been waiting for a kid like you to show up!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Wouldn't it be something if you ended up becoming the next RADder, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Oh, don't forget to let me know when you're gonna be in events and stuff! I'll be there rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Anyway, enough talk.
Let's get this set list out of the way.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now Akito's all fired up.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I can see that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
All good in my book!
Let's hurry up and do this already!
Chocolate Factory

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: We'll now start making our chocolates. Please feel free to ask the staff if you ever need any help.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: In addition, the staff here have experience working as patisseries, so you'll have their full support.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: We'll be going around to each table in order shortly. Again, please feel free to ask us any questions.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Cool, we can ask them for advice.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! I might have some questions for them later.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, Li'l Bro, you know what you're gonna make?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm thinking chocolate truffles.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Chocolate truffles? Aren't those really hard to make?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The recipe says all you have to do is break up the chocolate, melt it and put them into trays. See...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa, you're right...!
That's way easier than I was expecting.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The hard part's gonna be dealing with all the non-chocolate ingredients.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Since we're here, I kinda want to spice things up a bit.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
So something different...
Oh, what about some of the nuts we saw earlier?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I thought about that...
But you know the way chocolate truffles melt in your mouth? I sorta still want them to do that from start to finish.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... Yeah, I see your point...

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
Do you have a question?
Is there anything I can help you with?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, it's the staff from earlier!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, I'd like to ask you something...

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
I see.
A way to spice up chocolate truffles...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes. Is there a way to make them more interesting, or at the very least, have a lighter aftertaste?

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: In that case, orange zest is a fairly standard option.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: They go great with chocolate because of that hint of sourness and bitterness they bring to the table. Not only that, they add a nice visual accent.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I see. A simple approach does seem more feasible than something complicated.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: By mixing in some orange zest to your molten chocolate, they should provide a nice mix of flavor and fragrance when you put them in your mouth.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: However, if orange zest proves to be a little too chunky or coarse, orange liqueur can be used instead to keep your truffles smooth.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Interesting...
Thank you for the advice.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I think I'll try making some orange zest and some with orange liqueur.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
Happy to help.
I'll go fetch some orange liqueur right away.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Good for you, Li'l Bro!
I bet your truffles are gonna turn out great.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I hope so too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
So, what are you gonna do?
You said you wanted to make something “cute”, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
Ta-daa! I brought a bunch of molds from home.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm gonna make chocolates in all sorts of shapes, sizes and flavors. Some can be white, while other bitter. My plan's to change up what I do as I do bit by bit.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nice. Sounds like you got a pretty elaborate setup all worked out.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, are you gonna make some for Ena?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Huh? You're kidding, right?
She's getting a box of Paul Hansen's chocolate.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I mean, you know how picky she is.
There's no way she'd ever eat any chocolates that I make.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I actually believe otherwise.
She might really like them, you know?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Again, you're kidding, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Still, it's nice to hear that you're getting her something no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But that begs another question. Who's getting these chocolates?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
My mom for one.
The rest are going to my teammates.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
Wait... All of these? You're making a ton.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, so...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I mean, Miku and the others definitely deserve to have some too.)

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Thank you for your patience. Here's the orange liqueur. I've also written down some examples of how much you should be using.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you very much. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's get started.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, let's♪ These are gonna be sooo good!
White Day
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, speaking of which...!
You guys, over here!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I've got a bad feeling about this...
Can I go home?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm? But we still need to practice.
Also, we have to hand these out.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Ugh...
I know...
Weekend Garage Stage

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Happy White Day, Shiraishi, Azusawa.
Thank you for Valentine's Day. Here's something in return.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow! These are from “Bear Stamp Honey Cookies”, right? The place where a bear supposedly makes all the cookies!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was drawn to this place by the smell. Is it that famous?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's all the rage at my school.
On top of being yummy, they look absolutely adorable.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Totally. Even the bag's super cute!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Let me guess... This place was wall-to-wall fancy decorations?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, the bear plushies and other cute decorations gave it a nice, feminine touch, but it was a bit crowded.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm surprised you even went in...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Why? The dining area had a long line, but I was able to get these cookies in fairly short order.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dude, that's not what I'm saying.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. I guess he just isn't bothered by those kinds of things.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Anyway, thanks, Toya!
I'm gonna savor every bite.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too! Especially since I've been meaning to go to this shop for a while now! Thank you so much, Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm glad you like them so much.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, here's mine.
Have at it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, are these the chocolates you made at the Chocolate Factory?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, did Akiyama tell you already...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yup!
You guys went through a lot that day, huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Mizuki even told me about that other cast member you had to help out!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Is that why you've been grinning this whole time?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Can you tell me what happened, Shinonome?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've already heard most of this story, but I'd also like to hear more about what happened when you performed alongside Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: When I performed...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Fine, I'll talk...
So, what happened was...

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line:
“*Sob*
*Cry*”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line:
“Alright!
Let's make some chocolates for Chocota!”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “Let's start making some chocolates... Is what I'd like to say, but I only eat them! I have no idea how to actually make them!”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “Some help would be much appreciated... You there! Why don't you help me make your idea a reality?!”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What? Me?

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line:
“Yes, you!
Your friend as well...!”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: After that, Akiyama helped Tsukasa make some chocolates while I took Chocota to the green room.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, how did you get him out of there?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? How...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: “It looks like Chocota's tuckered himself out from crying a little too much, so why don't we give him some time to rest?”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: “Alright, let's all wave goodbye to Chocota for now! See you later!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hahaha...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
W-Wave goodbye to Chocota...?!
I can't picture you saying that, Akito...! H-Hehe...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Will you quit laughing already?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But that's incredible, Shinonome!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Not only did you get thrown into a really tough situation, you ad-libbed perfectly!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. I noticed the same thing when we were a part of that flash mob. Your versatility seemingly knows no bounds.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Compliments are nice, but I can't really say that I'm happy about all this...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot. Haruka Kiritani was there too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I heard!
She messaged me saying that she saw you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But she didn't really mention anything else...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was only able to put everything together after Mizuki told me the rest today. Understandably, you guys had to keep everything a secret.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess we shouldn't expect anything less from a former A-list idol, unlike a certain someone who can't stop giggling.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh? Who might that be?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ugh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Anyway, that's enough of that.
Let's start practicing already.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! Thanks for sharing that story with us!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, thank you. I feel like I could hear it over and over again...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dude, gimme a break...
Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Toya's busy with library committee stuff, so I guess I'll head off to practice first.)

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Hey, has your class chosen its members for the cheer squad?

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
No, not yet.
We're supposed to draw straws for that soon.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(The cheer squad, huh...?
The regular events sound fun, but I'm not really interested in that so...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, Akito!
Excellent! I'm glad you're still here!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Huh?! Tsukasa?!
Wait, who's this...?

rows.Speaker: Red Squad Captain
rows.Line:
Nice to meet you.
You must be the “Red Hare” that Tenma here was talking about.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: R-Red Hare?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I don't really know what's going on, but I'm probably gonna get roped into something annoying if I don't do something...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but I was asked to do something urgent so you'll have to ask someone else. Bye!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Darn... There he goes.
But did you see how fast he is?
I mean, look at that acceleration!

rows.Speaker: Red Squad Captain
rows.Line:
Yes, his speed is tremendous!
Isn't there a way for us to get him to join the red cheer squad?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Despite his outward appearance, he's a very understanding person. We'll just need to remain firm and keep trying!
The next day
Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate A
rows.Line: Hm? You're sighing. What's got you so down this morning?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, I sorta don't want to be at school today.

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate B
rows.Line: Why's that? Is something bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Something unbelievably... Crap!

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate A
rows.Line: Akito? Why are you hiding under your desk...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Quiet! Don't tell them that I'm here!

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate A
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Good morning, everyone!
Is Akito Shinonome here?!

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate B
rows.Line: Oh, you were talking about the Wombo Combo... You poor thing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Just say that I'm not here yet!

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate B
rows.Line:
Okay, okay.
Sorry, but Akito isn't here yet!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, I see. I'll have to come back later.
Until then, farewell!

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate B
rows.Line: He said he's gonna come back.

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate A
rows.Line: Sounds like he isn't stopping until he gets a chance to talk to you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Grr... Why's this happening?
Lunch break

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'd really rather not step outside this classroom.

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate A
rows.Line: Haha! Yeah, Tenma's probably waiting outside to ambush you!

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate B
rows.Line: But doesn't that mean your partner's waiting for you too?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Right...
Well, I guess I'm not having lunch with Toya for a while...
Akito, you there...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Perfect.
Sorry, Toya, but could you...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate A
rows.Line: Yikes... Busted!

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate B
rows.Line: We'll be sure to clean up after you, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Shut it!
Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What? The cheer squad? Me?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! We have a part that only an athlete such as yourself can fill. The Red Hare!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, from the saying, “Among men, Lu Bu; Among steeds, Chi Tu, the Red Hare.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
That doesn't help me at all...
Plus, I'm not really interested in joining the cheer squad, so can't you just ask someone else?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. So that means you'd be willing to join if we got you interested somehow.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? No, just ask someone else to...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Challenge accepted! After all, you are the most qualified candidate for this part!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Just you wait, Akito! Once I speak to the Captain about this, we'll find a way to get you interested!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No, I'm not gonna...!
Honestly, he never listens to what anyone says...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But why do you think he wants you to join so badly?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There must be a reason behind him taking such a liking to you, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Who knows?
A few days later

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate A
rows.Line: Akito looks really tired...

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate B
rows.Line: Well, duh. Tenma's been all over his case about “the cheer squad being so great” and “what it means to be the Red Hare”...

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate A
rows.Line: He sounds convinced that “Akito's the only one” or something.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
And it's a huge pain...
Ugh... Can't I just have a normal break?

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate B
rows.Line: You probably have no choice but to join the cheer squad at this point.

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate A
rows.Line:
I mean, can't you just agree to it?
It sounds like an important role. To be honest, I'm kinda interested in hearing what that involves.

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate B
rows.Line:
Yeah, me too!
All the stuff Tenma talked about seemed pretty fun too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What? You're seriously saying that?

rows.Speaker: Class Representative
rows.Line: Everyone, we'll be choosing members for the cheer squad before homeroom starts!

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate A
rows.Line:
Oh, I totally forgot.
We're doing that today...

rows.Speaker: Class Representative
rows.Line: At least two people will need to go from each class, but there is no actual limit. Those who wish to join are always welcome.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Geez...

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate A
rows.Line:
Let's give the cheer squad a try, Akito!
We'll be right there with you!

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate B
rows.Line: Once you agree to join, I'm sure you'll get to have lunch and nap in peace.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
...
*Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No running when push comes to shove, alright?

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate A
rows.Line: We know!

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate B
rows.Line:
Okay, that settles that!
Hey, the three of us would like to volunteer!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Things are gonna settle down once I agree to this, right...?
Kamiyama High School - Campus

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm gonna go warm up for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate A
rows.Line: Oh, right. You're supposed to be in the scavenger hunt.

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate B
rows.Line: Yeah! Break a leg, Red Hare!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ugh... Will you please...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heya, Li'l Bro! What's up?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You getting ready for the scavenger hunt too?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Wait, Toya, why are you here?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I just happened to be nearby.
Also, I'm interested in seeing the scavenger hunt.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We were just talking about how he should've asked to be in it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, why didn't you?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was told that I should be in the ball toss based on my height. Apparently, some people have trouble just getting the ball to reach the basket.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Toya isn't exactly great at ball sports...
But I guess his height does give him an advantage.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I asked Akiyama this question earlier, but what kind of assignment are you hoping to draw?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm hoping for towels since everyone's probably got one.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I see.
I guess... As long as it's not a person.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A person?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. For example, “someone tall”. That means I'd probably have to find someone that's as tall as you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, you can't just bring yourself?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nope. Neither you nor anything on your person can be turned in during the hunt.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, the rule about having to treat everything as “objects” is pretty lame since it means we have to carry whatever we find.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: To be fair, you can pull whatever you find or whoever you choose by hand if you have trouble schlepping it or them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's sort of my point. There's a huge gray area but it's up to us to judge what's actually allowed. I don't want to be called out in the end for “breaking the rules”...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see. It's not just about speed.
Your luck also plays a role in how well you do.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yup... Which is why I don't want to draw something that involves another person.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah, I get what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Unfortunately, Li'l Bro, I think you just jinxed yourself. Remember what happened at the Chocolate Factory?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, yeah.
Oh, Toya, mind lending me a hand with some stretches?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: The Kamiyama High School Sports Festival has begun! Our opening event is turning into a heated battle for first place between the red and blue teams!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, first one here...

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: Oh, Shinonome from the red team's got his assignment! Everyone, can you guess what it says?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Assignment
rows.Line: “Someone with a very loud voice.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Li'l Bro, I think you just jinxed yourself.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (You've gotta be kidding me...!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Someone!
I need an accessory with a ribbon motif!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Smell you later, Li'l Bro!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Grr...!
Why'd you have to go and do that, Ena...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ugh... Looks like I don't have a choice...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
It's only the first event and I already feel exhausted...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But I guess it all worked out in the end since I still somehow managed to get first...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. Congratulations...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, what are you taking a picture for?
Also, why are you here?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I left something here and came to get it. This one's to show Mom when I get home.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What? She doesn't have to see that.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Aww, but that scavenger hunt was so fun. I mean, look, my video turned out so well.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
<Hah hah hah!
We're cruising past everyone!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: <I know! Please, just be quiet for a bit...!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What do you think? Outside of me shaking the camera by accident when Mizuki fell, it's pretty good, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You had to go and take this too...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So? I got you basking in the limelight, didn't I? And you're in the cheering competition, right? I'm looking forward to seeing your performance.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? You just came to pick up something, right? Go home already.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Fine, be that way. Anyway, I'll see you later.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ugh...

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate A
rows.Line:
Hey, there he is!
Akito, nice job!

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate B
rows.Line: We were joking about you being the Red Hare, but you did amazing!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Look, I didn't really have a choice.

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate A
rows.Line: Haha! But the red team's in first place thanks to you!

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate B
rows.Line: Let's keep this up!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, we're definitely in it to win it...

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate A
rows.Line: Exactly! Let's go, red team!

rows.Speaker: Akito's Classmate B
rows.Line: Yeah!
Weekend Garage
Stage

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, this seems like a good place to take a break...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay. Great work, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We've already been singing for two hours.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
Time really flew by us there.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That means we were just that focused, right? You and Toya even seem more motivated than usual, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Sitting down to talk with Tono and his partner was huge.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (We have a much better understanding of each other now, and it's become clear that we're all after the same dream.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Well, to be fair, there are still some loose ends...)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: What does it mean to “take a look at this city”?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: That's what Taiga told me to do the other day.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: “If you're serious about surpassing RAD WEEKEND...take a look at this city.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Look at this city...?
I've been thinking about it ever since but still don't have a clue.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Still, Tono seems a lot better, so right now, we gotta think about making our event a success.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (The last time we all practiced together, we didn't do nearly as well as we'd hoped we would. So next time...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shinonome...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Everything okay? What's got you bothered?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, my bad...
I was just thinking about our next practice together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Each team's having no problem giving a quality performance...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But we're still not synergizing.
Remember how we all felt after our last full practice?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: At our current rate, we'll put on a “decent event”, but hardly an “event that surpasses that night”.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Exactly.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: My guess is that every team's gonna have to push each other higher and higher if we really want to recreate the crazy atmosphere from that night...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, RAD WEEKEND was nuts from start to finish, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, duh! Aunt Nagi even kicked it off with a solo performance! Of course it was nuts!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, she really just grabbed a hold of the crowd's hearts and made them go absolutely wild.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But the biggest surprise was how that energy never faded. It just grew and grew as the night went on.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah. It was like Shinonome said.
Every team competed to be the best and pushed each other higher and higher.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I agree.
As such, it makes sense to try and emulate that synergy, but...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's not the whole story, right...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I hate to say it but are we just not good enough...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We all know that we're nowhere near their level, so that's probably the wrong place to look.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: After a lot of discussion, we decided to keep the order of our performances the same too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I really think EVER needs to lead things off for us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They've been performing for pretty long now and have way more stage experience than us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which is why we need them to immediately warm up the crowd with the first song.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: At the same time, Mita's also been very impressive considering how he has to carry the baton from EVER to Tono.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I thought so too! I sorta couldn't believe it during our rehearsal the other day.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me neither. Not only is he singing really well, but he's also great at interacting with the crowd as the MC.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Apparently, he's been thinking about how to give a performance that suits him while also acting as a bridge.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That makes sense. He was definitely doing his best to get everyone excited for the next act as the MC.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Seriously, when did he learn to do all this...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And Tono... Well, I think this goes without saying...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. We're just practicing, but he's performing like it's the real thing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right. It's like he was able to wrangle up the entire place the second he started singing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: From there on out, he just let his presence grow stronger and stronger.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I bet the crowd would've been bouncing off the walls! But we're also supposed to go right after him and he's raising the bar sky high for us...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And that's exactly what we want.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Totally! We aren't gonna surpass that night unless we all push each other as hard as possible.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We have to take whatever energy that's there, mix it with our own and change it into something even greater...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We may not have been able to find the synergy we were looking for this time, but I believe we're on the right track.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, same.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, what we're missing is...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Pancakes...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, huh? Are you hungry or something?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No.
I was reminded of something KAITO said.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. You aren't guaranteed to end up with delicious pancakes just because you gathered up some good ingredients, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. We aren't gelling as well as we want because we still don't have a good understanding of each other.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If that's the case, let's talk some more with Mita and the others. For example, we ask them about why they decided to start singing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, great idea! I wanna ask them that too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, me too!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's bring it up during our next practice.
Studio

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, there you are!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yeah, everyone's already here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well, except for a few members from EVER...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Yeah, sorry about that. This live house we've been performing at asked some of us to help out, so it'll just be me for now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Got it.
In that case, we can start our debrief with who we have here.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Okay. Why don't we start by watching the video of our event?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I still can't believe how well EVER does right out of the gates... It's only the first song and everyone's this excited.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: The audience must've enjoyed seeing some familiar faces as well. It likely served as a signal to them that they could dive right into the action.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Yeah, we were hoping for something like that and it really let us cut loose from the start.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Wh-Whoa...!
I really got the crowd going, huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, you did a great job of interacting with the crowd and bridging between acts too! It probably felt pretty good up there, right?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I was way too nervous to remember!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: People usually aren't so honest...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I felt it that time too, and I know EVER and Mita helped warm up the crowd. But to get them this excited...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (All on his own too...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (No, he wasn't alone...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He's carrying Soma's thoughts too.)
song00005_off_f

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha. I look like I'm having a blast!
But I got so excited that I started speeding up my tempo.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Me too...
I might've been better to build the tension there more.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
No, the crowd was going that wild.
It was right for you to ride that wave.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: You two knew that and just let things play out, right, Akito, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They probably would've gone even more nuts if we had them clap along, so I was looking for a place to work that in.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: What? How were you able to think so calmly in that sort of electric atmosphere?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We were the headliners, right?
It was our duty to take them from you and get them even more excited.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Whoa... That means I've gotta find a way to perform without breaking a sweat too.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Well, that's just a matter of gaining experience.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Man, that was so much fun! I'm glad we got to rewatch everything and discuss it as a group!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, don't forget that this is still a debrief...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's watch it again.
This time, we can stop it at parts we think need more work and talk about it from there.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
This is to make our event even better.
I'd like it if we could be frank about what happened.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Of course. I won't have it any other way.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Uh... I'm the type that grows through praise... So, please go easy on me...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Oh, hear that?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I can't wait to discuss Mita's performance.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Toya, help!
They're starting to freak me out! Look at their eyes!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Really? From my point of view, they seem to be having fun...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: That's why they're scaring me!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Actually, Kotaro, there were some things concerning your performance that I was hoping to discuss.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Why are you going along with this, Tono?!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Because that's how things are rolling?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see... Is this what it means to synergize?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Dude, no!

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (From finding our partners to forming a team and performing in events, we've all been through a lot...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But it really feels like we've taken a big step towards making our dreams come true.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Alright, we've gotta take this first step and make it so our next one means just as much!)
One early morning
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Shinonome, good morning!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Good morning.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, we're all here. We'll start our morning practice once we've warmed up.

rows.Speaker: Kohane, An & Toya
rows.Line:
Okay!
Okay.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, let's do some stretches together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sure!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, mind if I take a moment before we start stretching? I'd like to drink that thing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, same here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, you guys brought more energy jelly today? It's like everyone's drinking that stuff now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They make for ideal breakfast substitutes because they go down smoothly even when it's warm out.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, this is really your breakfast?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. My mom's been busy and has been coming home very late recently, so I'd rather not ask her to do more by waking up early to make some for me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, I know what you mean.
You want her to rest since she's probably really tired.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hang on...
Kohane, did you not have any breakfast today?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, I did. I asked my parents to buy bread and jam for me, so I had some of that today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I suppose I could do the same.
Spreading jam over bread seems simple enough.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What about you, Akito?
I figured you had a full meal before coming here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I took a quick look what was in the fridge and fixed myself a light breakfast.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, you can make your own food?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Just fried eggs and salads mostly.
Oh, and some bread to go along with that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, that is pretty light.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I tend to want to eat a lot since I feel like I need to in order to get my voice going.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You eat a lot regardless of the time of day. Morning, noon or night.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Har har. Joke's on you. I work it all off throughout the day by singing!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But the part about eating a lot...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (She didn't deny that fact...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Still... It's important to eat three meals per day! I'm sure it's good for your health!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Exactly! See, Kohane gets it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No, I sorta get it too.
I used to eat a ton before I started going out for runs.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, you run?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's news to me too.
When did this happen?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Pretty recently.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I have to work harder than anyone else...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's why I decided that I'm gonna do everything I absolutely can.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Don't give me that look. I promise not to go overboard.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I'm having a hard time finding the time to actually go for runs, so I've decided to get off two stations early and run the rest of the way to morning practices.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: T-Two-stations?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. That's why I have a light breakfast, which is why I need this energy jelly to hold me over until lunch.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Everything you can, huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? What?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, nothing. You're just as self-disciplined as ever, I guess.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, Kohane, wanna try going for a run sometime?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I'd like to increase my stamina too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I didn't exercise at all in junior high, so I probably have the least out of all of us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In that case, I'd like to join you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I haven't exercised much up until now either.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (They call me the self-disciplined one, but they better not get carried away themselves.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, why don't we all go for a run together? Nonogi Park's got plenty of trees and shade, so it shouldn't be too bad even when it's hot out.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Really? I'd like that a lot.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, me too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, sounds good!
Let's all go for a run next time!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure.
Early morning
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Alright, it's time to kick off the first ever Vivid BAD SQUAD Footrace!>

rows.Speaker: Len & KAITO
rows.Line: <Yeah!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane, An & Toya
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<What was that, Akito?!
You call that spirit?!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, I mean, this was your idea.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, I suggested that the four of us go for a run and...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But why are all of you here?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I told them about us going for a run when I popped over to SEKAI to practice some stuff on my own the other day. Then...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <It sounded like fun and we had some free time, so we decided to join you.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He's grinning. Is he actually being serious...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <KAITO's always like this.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <But we really are here to give you guys our support!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Yeah, just look!
We brought a megaphone, whistles and everything.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <We're gonna cheer like crazy to make sure you guys get in a really good run!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I really appreciate you guys' support. I feel like I'll be able to run better now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: See? Kohane's okay with them being here. Also, no one else is here this early in the morning, so it's all good, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And I'm guessing that you guys won't leave even if we ask you to...

rows.Speaker: Rin, Len & KAITO
rows.Line: <Yup!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright, shall we start warming up?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Beginning with some stretches!
One, two, three, four!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa, that's way too fast!

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line:
Hehehe!
Haha!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, let's start with a lap around the park...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, let's go.

rows.Speaker: KAITO's Voice
rows.Line:
<Oh, you're going pretty fast!
If only I could feel the wind as you ran.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're not even looking. How do you know that I'm going fast?

rows.Speaker: KAITO's Voice
rows.Line: <Because I'm being shaken around!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I was a fool for asking...

rows.Speaker: Len's Voice
rows.Line: <Toya, are you swinging your arms like we said?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'm running using the form you taught me. At least, I believe I am.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Make sure to swing your arms too, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right...! One, two... One, two...!

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line: <That's it, Kohane! You're doing great!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And... We're finished!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
W-We did it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we did. My arms and legs started getting heavy partway through, but I never really felt out of breath...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, we practice singing a ton every single day.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <That's right. Your lung capacity should be fairly good now.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Anyway, now what? You guys gonna do another lap after a quick break?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, we should stop for today since we have to practice after this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
We should save our energy for then.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Make sure to stretch well, Toya.
I have a feeling that you're gonna be pretty sore again.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Again?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, because of what happened during the Sports Festival?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I overdid things a little during the ball toss and my arms had to pay for it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: When I woke up the next day, I could lift them up at all. It was almost as if they'd become completely paralyzed.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Wait, it was that bad?!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I was just as surprised.
However, it also felt like a badge of honor for having tried my best during the Sports Festival.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's also every reason that we should keep doing these workouts.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, let's do another run together sometime!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Alright, everyone, hop on over to SEKAI once you're ready. MEIKO's whipped up some nice, cool drinks for all of you.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Did you ask her to do that for us?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hehe. I didn't have much else to do.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, we'll head over.
Arcade

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Ugh... Ena...
Asking me to do something completely pointless just as I'm about to head out the door...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I barely managed to get here on time, but Toya said that he got here a little while ago...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, there he is.
Sorry, Toya...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I appreciate the invitation. Unfortunately, I have a prior engagement today...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Who's he talking to...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Again, I'm sorry.
My friend's waiting, so if you'll excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry for being late, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Ah, Akito.
Did everything go okay with your sister?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay? I mean, she made me go and get something for her.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: More importantly, who were you talking to just now? What was that about an invitation...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, that was somebody from a pro gaming agency. They just happened to be at the gaming tournament the other day and asked me if I was interested in playing professionally.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, you were being recruited?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It seems that way.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
To be fair, you were pretty incredible.
Especially when we played Puyo Puyo.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: K-Kusanagi's building faster than her teammate, Otori, was just a moment ago...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: But Aoyagi's on a completely different level! He's dropping Puyo's into place the second they appear on the screen! I-It's impossible to see what's going on!!

rows.Speaker: Student in the Audience
rows.Line:
Wh-What's going on?
Is he beginning to panic or something?!

rows.Speaker: Man in the Audience
rows.Line: No, he's dropping them into all the right spots. Not only that, but if he gets this chain to go off, we're going to see something even more ridiculous than we just did...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I still can't believe you pulled that off.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I just did what I practiced.
It's no different from singing.

rows.Speaker: We're The Best A
rows.Line: Hm? Isn't that...?

rows.Speaker: We're The Best B
rows.Line:
Hey, it's Willow & Cloud.
Fancy seeing you guys here...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Aren't you guys We're The Best...?

rows.Speaker: We're The Best A
rows.Line: Yeah, that's us. We've been coming here in the hopes that we'd run into you guys, and it finally happened.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Hm? Something seems different about them...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You wanted to see us...?
May I ask why?

rows.Speaker: We're The Best B
rows.Line:
Isn't it obvious?
We owe you a debt.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A debt?

rows.Speaker: We're The Best A
rows.Line: You know, because of what happened during the gaming tournament...?

rows.Speaker: We're The Best B
rows.Line:
So, um...
We'd like to play against you guys again. Fair and square this time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I thought I was just imagining things, but they do seem a bit more... Mature, I guess?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Their competitive spirit's still there, but they seem way less hasty or reckless.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(And I think they're telling the truth.
It looks like they learned their lesson after what they tried to pull during the tournament.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What do you think, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I don't feel great about losing, so a fair rematch could be...)

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Weren't they in that tournament the other day?

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line: Whoa, cool! You think they're gonna have a rematch?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, people are starting to congregate...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That might be a deal breaker...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry, we just stopped by to have some fun today, so we're gonna take a rain check.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And we still have practice after this.)

rows.Speaker: We're The Best A
rows.Line:
That's all good. We understand...
Maybe next time.

rows.Speaker: We're The Best B
rows.Line:
You guys can always ask us too.
We're usually here whenever we have free time.

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line:
Hey, We're The Best!
Can I ask you guys for a match if you guys are free?

rows.Speaker: We're The Best A
rows.Line:
Heh. Someone sounds confident.
Alright, you're on.

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line: Good luck!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
They've totally melded in here...
I'm guessing they're regulars here now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Based on their current behavior, I have a feeling that their cheating days are over.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Junior High Schooler A
rows.Line: Go, 5-chain, go!

rows.Speaker: Junior High Schooler B
rows.Line: Noooo! If only I got a Red Puyo! Then my chain would've gone off!

rows.Speaker: High Schooler A
rows.Line:
Whoa, check this out!
This booth lets you do so much! I'm gonna give myself some eyelash extensions!

rows.Speaker: High Schooler B
rows.Line:
Haha!
No one's gonna recognize you if you edit yourself that much!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sounds like they're all having a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, they do.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This atmosphere. It's similar to what you feel on Vivid Street. There's an air of fun but it's also soothing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, kinda.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, we don't have much time left until practice, so let's do what we came here to do.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. An artist you like worked on the music for one of the games here, yes?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah. The shooters are...
Over there. Let's go, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.
Arcade

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, here it is.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
“Gunslinger Jungle”...?
Is the song playing right now the one by that artist you like?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. They mostly do EDM stuff, but they also produce some chiptune music on the side and were asked to do that for this game.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That explains why I'm hearing all these game-like sounds.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, the characters in this game are very cute. It's as if they were all designed to look like animals...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: From what I remember, the story for this game's about them joining together to protect the jungle they all live in from aliens.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Considering an artist you like worked on the music for this game, Akito, I was under the impression that it'd be more realistic, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I wouldn't have invited you out if it were. I know you don't like that kind of stuff.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I had a feeling that you'd be okay with this game since it had more of an anime feel to it. I mean, the villains are aliens.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you, Akito.
I should have no problem enjoying this game.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Glad to hear that.
So, let's give it a go.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, we start by choosing our characters. What do we have? A monkey, an owl, a tiger, a koala, a panda, an alligator...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
A lion, a zebra, a wolf, a hyena...
Don't these animals live in the savannah, not the jungle?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
To be fair, it's a video game.
I think we can cut it some slack there.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm looking for something that's agile, so I think I'll go with the wolf...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, I'll go with the panda.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The panda? What can it do?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Based on its character description, it seems to be very hardy and resilient. Furthermore, you can use its skills to protect your allies.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You know we're just here to have fun, right? You could've just gone with whatever you wanted.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No worries there.
I chose the panda because we seemed to see eye to eye.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Eye to eye...? You know... Hm?
Oh, someone wants to play with us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You can do that?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, if we play together, we'll get to play against a special boss.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Shall we give it a try?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, let's do it.
I'll hit accept.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They sent a stamp saying, “Looking forward to playing with you.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya, it's starting. Get ready... Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Geez, we're surrounded right off the bat?! What happened to being beginner-friendly?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Wait, Akito, look.
Our friends are that owl and alligator. They're jumping up and down while waving their hands.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
How do you do that?
What's the command for...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No time for that!
Shoot the baddies!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, that just leaves the final stage.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I wasn't sure if we'd make it at first, but luckily, none of the enemies were very smart or mobile.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: After all, this is a stage for beginners that includes a tutorial.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, I was wondering why all these items were dropping.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, that owl and alligator are really good.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, they are. The alligator's a strong attacker that can charge in and break enemy formations while the owl provides support fire from the rear. They're each playing a clear role.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The owl in particular isn't doing anything flashy, but it really seems to know what it's doing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It hits anything that tries to flank us and even guides enemies towards us in a way that makes it easy for us to take them out.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, the boss stage is about to start.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, this must be the special stage you were talking about.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, but I have no idea what we'll be fighting... Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hang on...
This green wall that's wriggling around... Is that...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, that's the enemy.
It looks like we can only see its torso...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why'd they make it so big?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Guh...! Let's finish this!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
There...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We did it, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, even though it was for beginners, this stage turned out to be pretty fun.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But I became so focused that I forgot to listen to the background music...)

Woohoo! We did it!
Nene, we won!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hm...?
That voice...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's coming from behind our machines.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess they have the same ones on the other side. Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I was worried that we wouldn't make it at first, but I'm glad that wolf and panda were so good...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! They even came to the rescue when that alien stepped on my alligator's tail and kept me from bouncing up and down!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess that's who we were playing with just now...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, our sisters-in-arms were right under our noses this whole time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I knew there was a reason why they were so good. That owl had to be Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh? Akito! Toya!
Hi!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why don't we chat with them for a bit? I mean, we worked pretty hard to bring down that gigantic boss.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sure.
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay... It may be better to emphasize the bass section more for that last part.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I agree.
That should give the chorus a little more pop.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Then, let's make that adjustment.
We can have Azusawa and Shiraishi listen to it tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Tomorrow...? That's sooner than normal. Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, and please don't worry.
I don't plan on staying up that late to work on this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What about you though? I noticed that you came here early to practice on your own. Please, try not to push yourself too hard...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
This is nothing.
And I don't want to make you worry again by doing too much.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, between practice and making your own track, you're not exactly taking it easy either. That means I should also be doing what I can.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Sounds like your efforts have lit a flame under Akito.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The same goes for me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Like him, I want to do what I can as well.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: These guys are like...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Well, I see no problem if they're saying that they're okay.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: However, how one performs can change drastically based on the way they spend their time preparing.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Yes, that's very true.
You can try all you want, but it's all for naught if you're too exhausted.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I get that...
But don't you guys do stuff outside of our joint practices?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I usually crash and fall asleep whenever I feel really tired. I'm usually all ready to sing by the time I wake up the next day!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I was asking about how you guys practice...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: He may be a bit of an extreme example, but I also like to rest whenever I can.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: I usually use that time to listen to our songs or watch videos of our shows to imagine how we're going to perform.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I also prefer to take it easy the day before long practices or rehearsals.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I may try to get a breath of fresh air by traveling somewhere far away to take photos or something else that's unrelated to music.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Those sorts of trips can also lead to some nice inspiration. Seeing things from new perspectives tend to help me put on better performances.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
See? I'm not crazy!
Taking breaks and resting is really important!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It sounds less compelling when you say it...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: In any case, working hard isn't the only way to put on better performances.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: So, why not set aside some days here and there to stop and smell the flowers?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I see... Then, it may be good for us to make some adjustments to our practice schedule.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I agree.
But for now, we gotta keep working on our new songs.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We can come back to that after the event.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What is it? You got something to say?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
No, not really.
It's just... You seem all prickly most of the time, but you're really not deep down.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Yeah, I thought you were pretty stubborn and unbending at first, but you're more flexible than I initially realized.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Give me some credit...
Of course I'm willing to try things that could prove beneficial to my team.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah, sorry, I wasn't trying to be mean or anything.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll be looking forward to hearing Vivid BAD SQUAD's new songs.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It goes without saying that we're gonna blow the roof off the place.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Hehe. I like that...
With the time we have left, let's all do our best to make our event a good one.
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, let's go with this set list.
Are we all good with that?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup! I'm okay with it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm also okay with it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, that settles that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And I feel our set list has become really good thanks to the addition of your track, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Totally! It adds such a nice accent.
I can't wait to see how the crowd's gonna react to it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm happy that you're saying that, but...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's up?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I know I should've said this sooner, but I'm sorry for making it without asking you all first.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not only did it take you all by surprise, but we have to practice even more now after deciding to perform two songs. It seems like such a large burden.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But it's not a burden.
We agreed to perform two songs because we all think that your song is just that amazing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, we sort of already knew that you were working on something.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, I had a feeling...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: However, it didn't seem like you were being bothered by anything, and you were doing fine during practice.

rows.Speaker: Akito
