rows.Line: In the end, we figured that there was nothing for us to worry about since you seemed to know what you were doing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And we had a feeling that you'd come talk to us if you needed our help.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, I wasn't expecting to hear that you were working on your own track.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Again, sorry about that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll let you all know the next time I do.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You don't have to tell us every single time. Just bring it over for us to listen if you think it's good.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And ask me for help if you ever need it. I'll always be willing to help.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, what he said!
I'll help too if you ever think you need it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, me too...!
That is, if you think I can help.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It could be fun to make a track together down the road.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that does sound fun...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I really wanna hear that song!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
A track by you two...
That does sound interesting. I wonder how it'll turn out.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's not like we've actually decided to make one... But I am looking forward to that prospect.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, what if you two started fighting while making it...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I hope we don't...
Akito, please tell me straight away without hiding it if something is bothering you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. When that happens, Kohane or I will step in to save the day.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'd appreciate that very much.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What are you all going on about...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're just making sure that we're prepared.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
More importantly, we have an event to think about.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: All good! I'm gonna do mental prep for our rehearsal starting tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Fine. In any case, we have a lot of work ahead of us if we plan on singing both our song and Toya's at a high level.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. Let's do our best to make our next event one to remember.

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: Yeah!
Shibuya Festa - Backstage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Our show went so well!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! We gotta tell Miku and the others about this!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, also!
If we're gonna head over there, we should get them some food from here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I suspect Len in particular would like that very much.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, it shouldn't take too long either. The stalls shouldn't be all that crowded right now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! But we have a lot of options to choose from. What should we get?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, Akito, that reminds me.
Are you sure you don't want to go say hi to your sister?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What? Nah, I'm good.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? Why not go see her for a bit? Also, I kinda wanna talk to Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I have no idea what she's doing right now, and I really don't feel like talking to her right now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Fine, be that way...
I'll ask Mizuki what they're doing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa, that was fast!
Uhh... “We're by the piano”...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, the one by Miyamasuzaka?
I remember seeing a piano sitting in the middle of the street near the stalls.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's right along the way home.
What do you say, Akito? That's no reason to avoid it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Fine, if it's just on the way...
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, there they are!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Everyone's clapping.
What do you think's going on?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Those two standing there...
I think they're from Ena's group...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I saw her at the first aid tent... What was her name? Asahina? Pretty sure she writes all the lyrics and mixes their songs...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, An! Over here!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
There you are, Mizuki!
Sorry! Thanks for waiting!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, you're here too...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This just happened to be on our way home.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Fun banter as always. Oh, here come Kanade and Mafuyu♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Great performance, you two!
Guess who's here? It's Li'l Bro and company!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello, it's nice to see you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, hello...
Your performance earlier was very good.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you for taking the time to see our show. I know you were busy. Oh, also, thank you for what you did when we were at the first aid tent...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Were you two playing the piano just now?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, um... Yes, that was us.
I felt compelled to since I hadn't played any musical instruments in a while.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sure you put on a very nice performance. A sense of awe seems to have come over everyone around here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And so many people were applauding just now. I wish I could've heard you play, Asahina...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. I appreciate your kind words, but it really wasn't much of a performance.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Really? But you two played so well together.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If only you'd asked your sister sooner, Akito, we might've been able to hear them play.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Don't you mean that you should've asked Akiyama sooner?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, Toya, there's something I wanna ask you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sure, ask away.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I forgot to ask you this before, but how were those cookies I got you? Did you like them?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu & Mizuki
rows.Line: Cookies?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, for getting revenge on this one claw machine that gave me a lot of trouble. He won the prize I wanted from it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, is this about PenPyon...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. I decided to buy some cookies to thank him, which I had Akito deliver.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you for getting those.
They were delicious and tasted of tea. It was a very nice gift.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Really? Then, I'm glad I bought them!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, what about me? You keep treating me like your personal servant. Don't I deserve some kind of reward?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What?
Is there something you want?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... Alright, fine. That okonomiyaki over there looks pretty good. How does that sound? My treat.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's not the point.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But fine. I won't say no to that...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What's with that tone?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm taking what I can get.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh? Then, hurry up and choose...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Pork and eggs? Squid and eggs?
Oh, wait. Toya doesn't like squid...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, so pork and eggs...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. It must be so nice to have siblings.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I like how open they are with one another.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, in their case, Li'l Bro has to do a lot of the compromising...
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That okonomiyaki was so good!
But Akito's sister ended up paying for everything...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I sort of feel guilty about having her buy our share.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, please tell your sister later how much we appreciate her gesture.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, sure thing.
I'll tell her when I get home.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, weren't we supposed to buy food for Len and the others?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
What should we get? More okonomiyaki?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
More?
Hang on. Shouldn't we just ask what they want?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha. Yeah, let's do that!
Lemme just tell them what's up and...

<Yeah, same!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<We know!
This isn't my first time, so I'll be...>

rows.Speaker: Toya

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<I'm interested in that red place!
The one behind Toya...!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Really? I wanna see what all those people are doing over there!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
What are they selling?

rows.Line: Alright, everyone, settle down...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I'm glad that they're enjoying everything so much.

rows.Speaker: Toya

rows.Line:
Then, let's split up to buy everything.
We can meet back up once we're all done.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay! Luka, you come with me.
I've been meaning to check out the baby castella stand.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, really? Thank you, An. Let's go!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: KAITO, you can come with me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Great! Lead the way, Toya!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Who are you taking, Shinonome?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Um, I'll take...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(I don't have any strong preferences...
But I wanna say that the roasted corn stall's pretty far from here...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'll take Len.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, Rin, let's get some shaved ice together.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Cool! Thanks, Kohane!
Let's go! It's that way!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, we should get going.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, let's go!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, alright.
Hey, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? That voice...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <It's Shota!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa, wait, hide...!

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
Thank goodness I found you.
I thought you'd gone home already.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I was actually about to, but decided to check out some of the stalls before I did. Anyway, what's up?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: It's not super important, but I thought that I should thank you...

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: I really appreciate you and your team participating in this event. You guys really made the whole place go wild!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's no big.
If anything, thanks for inviting us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This ended up being a good experience for us, I mean, it's not every day that you get to perform on such a big stage.

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Right. Then, I'm glad I invited you guys!

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
I'll see you around, Akito!
Again, thanks for the awesome performance!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Hmm... Interesting...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I pretty much stopped talking to Shota after I quit playing soccer. But now, we're back to seeing each other kinda often...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, Shota!

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Hm? Yeah?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Um... If you end up working on another event, make sure to let us know, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Does that mean you'll perform in the next one...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It'll depend on the situation, but we're friends, right? I might be willing to lend you a hand.

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Thanks! I'll keep that offer in mind!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure thing. Anyway, see you...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What are you smiling about?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Oh, nothing...
Anyway, let's hurry up and get us some roasted corn!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, fine...
After school
Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Once again, I'm sorry. See you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(*Sigh*
I didn't expect my math homework to take so long.)

rows.Line: (Toya and the others already went on ahead, so I oughta catch up.)

rows.Line: Yo, Akito! It's your birthday today, right?

rows.Line: Yeah. What about it?

rows.Line: You like sweet stuff, don'tcha? It's nothing fancy, just from the convenience store, but we got you this Swiss roll. Happy birthday, man!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Seriously? Thanks, that's nice of you.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Catch ya later!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'm surprised they remembered. Also...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't like how quiet it feels today... The corridor's usually noisier than this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, I've gotta get going to practice. No time to stare into space.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Okay, gotta hurry...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm?
Rustle rustle rustle!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Is that...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm gonna ignore that.
Huh?! Rustle rustle rustle! What could be in this incredibly suspicious tall grass?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I probably shouldn't get close to it if it's suspicious.
Well, maybe! But, then we can't do the “Suspicious Rustling Grass! What's Inside? Whoa, Wonderhoy!” Birthday Surprise...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You kinda ruined the “surprise” there.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Argh, it's time for Plan B! Everyone, he's not coming to us! We gotta get on the attack!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Happy wonderhoy birthday jump!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wh-What the...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Akito!!! Happy birthday!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene & Rui
rows.Line:
H-Happy birthday...
Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Oh, now it makes sense... It seemed so quiet because these guys weren't around.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Otori, did you sneak into our school again?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I heard it was your birthday and knew we had to put on a show for you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Except shows aren't a necessary part of birthdays, you know?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thanks to some improvements I made, the ejection device that we used at Shibuya Festa can now eject two performers at once. And what better chance to have you see it than on your birthday?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So you're using my birthday as an excuse to use that huge ejection thing?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No no no, that's not true. I genuinely would like to celebrate your birthday and leave you smiling.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't trust you...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey! Where are you going, Nene?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
...
I was just...heading to the restroom.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Kusanagi...
If you didn't want to do it, you could've stopped them in the first place...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-I told them I was against it! It's embarrassing to put on a surprise show where all of our classmates can see...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What do you mean, Nene? You were the one saying, “Well, if it's just singing 'Happy Birthday' for him, I guess it'd be fine.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I didn't mean here! So what, I have to sing at the school gate for all the world to see?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm. If that's how you feel, then let's drop that idea.

rows.Line: However, even if we're no longer singing, we still have a show prepared for you!

rows.Line: A show by the name of... “The Road of Vivid BAD SQUAD!”

rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Line: Toya has filled me in on everything that took place from the day you two met to the formation of your team. And today, you will see our adaptation of that!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, without further ado: I am Akito Shinonome!!! I will surpass the legendary night!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I'm Kohane Azusawa! I'm...going to sing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm Toya Aoyagi♪
Do I even...have the right to sing with you?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: S-Surely I'm too unbelievable as Shiraishi?! Someone switch with me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You can do it, Nene! Have confidence!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What the heck am I being made to watch...?

rows.Line: Ugh, I thought that would never end... Though, I guess it was pretty funny.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Line: It is you! Hello, Akito!

rows.Line: Oh... Hinomori and Asahina? Why are the two of you...

rows.Line: Hello. The two of us are on our way home from archery club.

rows.Line: By the way, Akito. Today is your birthday, right?

rows.Line: Um, yes it is.

rows.Line: (His birthday... Come to think of it, Ena and Mizuki were talking about it last night.)

rows.Line: (They were talking about preparing something for him...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I know. They're nothing special but here, have these!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: These are...?

rows.Line: Cough drops. I just bought them earlier for myself, but you and your team work so hard on singing. I imagine you need them too.

rows.Line: Oh, that's very thoughtful. Thank you very much.

rows.Line: Ah... I'm so sorry. I'm afraid I have no gift prepared for you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Please don't trouble yourself, but I appreciate the sentiment. Besides, you already do so much for my sister.

rows.Line: That's not true at all. Ena is far more capable than I am.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Haha, I'm pleased to hear it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Once again, happy birthday. I hope you have a wonderful year ahead.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's very kind. Thank you so much, both of you.

rows.Line: Hm? A message?

rows.Line: “Let's meet up in SEKAI today. We've gone ahead to warm up.”

rows.Line: Yikes, I really do need to hurry now.

rows.Line: I'd better be going now, if you'll excuse me!

rows.Line: I should be thanking you, MEIKO. This was more than I could have ever expected.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? A present?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! We put a lot of thought into these and chose them together♪ Here you go!

rows.Line: Hehe, open it up, Akito! We also helped pick your present.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We hope you like them...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks, guys. Okay, I'm opening it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, these...are the running shoes I wanted!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, for real?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really? You mentioned you wanted new running shoes when we passed by the shoe store one time on the way home, so that's why we chose shoes...

rows.Line: But we didn't know what design you would like, so we spent a long time looking around with Len and the others. Who would've thought we'd pick just the ones you wanted!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It was a good thing that Toya said these were the best right at the last minute!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I have to admit though, it was just intuition... I'm glad they were the ones Akito wanted.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You guys... Thank you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, happy birthday Akito! I'm excited to see where we go from here!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Likewise. Thanks, everyone.

rows.Line: We came back at a perfect time of day. After this I can...

rows.Line: Oh yeah, Akito! Do you have time after this?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? After this?

rows.Line: I was gonna go running. Gotta try out my new shoes, after all.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Do you run even on your birthday, Shinonome?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Days like today are when I'm most careful. I'll lose my pace if I relax too much and let myself slack off.

rows.Line: I suppose that makes sense.

rows.Line: Guess I'll grab something from the fridge...

rows.Line: Here!

rows.Line: Hm? Is this...a cake?

rows.Line: Yup! It's a homemade cheesecake! And it looks delicious, right?

rows.Line: It does look good... Did you make this? The decoration on top is pretty well made.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmph... Airi and Mizuki made that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Momoi and Akiyama?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. Your birthday came up yesterday, and Mizuki suggested that you might like this kind of thing every now and then.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But we weren't confident enough to do it ourselves, so we got Airi to help us out.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wow... I gotta say thank you to those guys.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait a second! Shouldn't you be saying thank you to someone else first?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Did you need that “well” just now?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, give it a rest. Anyway, I'll be digging in now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, you should use a fork! Just wait, I'll go get one!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Geez, the cake's not going anywhere...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Honestly, with all these people celebrating with me, this hasn't been a bad birthday.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The cake we made was good, right? Make sure you get something tasty for my birthday too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Li'l Bro! Hehehe, wasn't the decoration for your cake the cutest? Let me know how it tasted when I see you♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Akito! I sneakily snapped some photos of Ena hard at work making your cake. I'll send you them later♪

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Happy birthday. Ena and Mizuki said that they had fun making your cake.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Akito! Keep at it with your singing. I'll be rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Akito! Happy birthday! Wasn't my rendition of Akito Shinonome one for the books? I think you could even learn some things from me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shinonome. From the look you had on your face, I take it he wasn't quite accurate?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, happy birthday... I'm sorry we kind of caused a ruckus... Did you like our show?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Happy wonderhoy birthday, Akito☆ Thank you for watching our birthday show! Let's game again sometime!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shinonome! I couldn't help but smile seeing how much you enjoyed the cakes that MEIKO and An's dad made.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Akito! It was so fun getting to celebrate both in SEKAI and over here! Oh, why don't we do a birthday show here too while we're at it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm glad we were able to celebrate with so many people today. Once again, happy birthday, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I have more friends and I do more events now... And I guess that means I now have more people to wish me happy birthday too. I'm grateful.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm not the type to get caught up in a celebration, but this is pretty nice once in a while.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But as soon as this break's over, you bet I'm gonna start running again, and as fast as I can.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're gonna keep on pushing forward... We have to.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And that's why I'm going to keep running, more than anyone else.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, I hope you'll stick around.
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We practiced singing for much longer than I was expecting.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Get home safe, okay, you guys?
You especially, Kohane, since you're such a cutie.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wah! A-An, I'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Geez...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Wait, Akito, I thought you were done training!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No way, dude. I've still got some stuff left to do.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, I'd like to join you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (We really ended up training together...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, see you all tomorrow.

rows.Line:
Bye!
Okay.
See you!

rows.Line:
(We practiced a lot...
But I feel so light for some reason.)

rows.Line: (I think I'll squeeze in another run.)

rows.Line: I'm back.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Welcome... Ew...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Geez, why the disgusted face?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's because you're all sweaty and gross.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Seriously, how did you get like that? It's freezing outside.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I ran.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You ran? I thought you guys were having an after party?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm still sticking to my regular training routine. Also, I sort of felt like running a little more than usual today.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay...?

rows.Line: Anyway, why don't you go take a bath? You're gonna catch a cold at this rate.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, I will.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You should be grateful since I came downstairs to take mine...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yes, your majesty.
Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, what's that supposed to mean?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?! Wh-What is it...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Maybe I was just imagining things...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Imagining what?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Have you been crying, Akito...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: At long last...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What makes you think that...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because the skin around your eyes looks kinda red.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Around my eyes?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. You've always done that.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Most people get bloodshot eyes when they cry, but you take out your frustration or anger by rubbing so hard that it's your skin that turns red instead.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Has this always been happening...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You didn't know?

rows.Line: To be fair, I had to look pretty closely before I noticed. You don't look nearly as bad as you did that other time.

rows.Line: I didn't admit to crying or anything. Also, what do you mean by “that other time”?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: When you just started to sing and perform. You should've seen the look on your face. I decided to just leave you be.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (She can be pretty sharp sometimes...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm letting you take a bath before me, so hurry up and go, will you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Okay, fine.
Don't start acting like a big sister on me all of a sudden.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Excuse me? I'm your big sister no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You sure about that?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Grr... The last person I wanted to know noticed...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Luckily, Toya and the others didn't...probably...)

*Sigh*
Time for that bath...

rows.Line: Is there anything else you need us to do?

rows.Line: We decided to accept your invitation since it's important to take breaks from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I was actually a little hesitant since I'm not a regular here...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: An and her team invited you all, right? That means you're more than welcome.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Thank you, Ken...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Now, let me take this opportunity to ask all of you. Who wants some of our special Christmas honey waffles?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, me! I want some!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Same.
Anyone else...?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Us too!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hahaha. I guess you're all craving something sweet.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Haha. To be fair, Akito's probably the only one here with a real sweet tooth.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, so are you. Remember how you got that chocolate parfait right after we did that show?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, is that true?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes. It's always nice to have something sweet whenever you feel tired. And it serves as a nice reward for myself.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: However, Akito, you seem to enjoy having sweets regardless of the situation.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? I...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, he does.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. It's true.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Hang on. Is that why you run so much?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No way, dude.
I always watch what I eat and save some for later.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Later? So you still end up eating it?

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Hahahaha.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright...
Let's get our Christmas party started!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Regulars
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Okay, sugar connoisseurs, your honey waffles are ready! Can someone carry them over for me?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes, I'll be right there!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You guys all having fun?
I think it's about time we started singing!

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line:
Yeah! 'Tis the season!
Nice idea, An!

rows.Speaker: Regular B
rows.Line: Especially since you've gathered a bunch of good singers together. Let's hear it!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: An seems awfully excited.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: She always seems to want to sing during these sorts of parties.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, she was pretty busy taking orders and serving everyone until just a second ago. I've gotta think that she's been looking forward to some free time.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Whoa, this place is packed.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hey, I'm not serving alcohol during the middle of the day. You'll just have to make do with coffee.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Fine.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, Taiga.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hey, you're here.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Looks like you feel a lot better now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes, I have you to thank for that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Um... I appreciate what you told me that time. About how things were back then.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
You don't need to thank me.
I just felt like talking is all.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Also, I'm sure that others are more worried about your well-being.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: If I didn't say anything, I have a feeling that they would have.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Right... Toya and the others rushed over after they'd heard what happened...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Hey, buck up.
It's Christmas, isn't it?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ow...! Wh-What was that for?!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hahaha!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You're young, so you're allowed to feel lost and ask others for help. I say use that privilege as much as you can.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, I will.
New Year's Eve - Early morning
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Yawn*
I'm so sleepy... I might just doze off...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm still a little sleepy too...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: As am I. It's rare for any of us to get up this early for anything...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Good, you're all here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Fortunately, our team doesn't include any snoozers like Ena.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, where's Ken?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: He's doing one final check of all the luggage. He said he's bringing some sound equipment along.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You guys look sleepy...
Do you have everything you need?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. Kohane and I have our matching fluffy socks, so we should be good...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Your what...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You seem totally awake, Shinonome.
Aren't you sleepy at all?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, I usually go jogging around this time, and I went for a run earlier this morning.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?! This morning...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I get anxious if I don't run.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa. You're just like Haruka.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I thought I was more or less a morning person, but four in the morning still feels super early.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we're not about to sing or anything, so why don't you guys just sleep during the drive over?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, it's not like we're gonna perform right when we get there.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, since we're not actually performing until later tonight. My dad said we can go skiing and stuff while he and his friend get everything set up!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, we're leaving the next day, but he also said that we'll have some time to hit the slopes before we go.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm really looking forward to that, but I'm also a little worried about actually being able to ski...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Me too. I feel both anxious and excited at the same time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anxious? Because you've never skied before?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. In particular, if I'll be able to stop myself... And how high the chairlift is going to be...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, the chairlift...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, they do go pretty high up...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But braking won't be an issue!
Akito and I can teach you that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, you'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you. I appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I really appreciate you guys teaching us!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, also!
My dad asked if there were any rest areas that you guys want to stop at.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're probably gonna take a few breaks along the way, so it'd be nice to stop somewhere fun, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Apparently, some have a really good breakfast service and others have public foot baths!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
A good breakfast sounds nice.
I grabbed a quick bite before I came over, but I'm starting to get hungry again after running.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
A foot bath sounds really nice too!
Especially since it's gonna be cold where we're going.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A foot bath? That may also be a first for me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. There's even a website with info about popular rest areas, so let's check it out later!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's great and all... But aren't you all forgetting our main objective?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, we haven't!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: However, since we're all going together, I feel that we should have a good time along the way!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. We took the train when we went camping, but we have a car this time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm hoping to see some new sights on our way over.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Me too!
Hehe. Do you think there'll be a chance to take a photo of the sunrise?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I think I remember seeing a rest area where you can get a really great view of it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So many stops.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Still, the stops we made during our camping trip ended up being fun and refreshing.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And there's no real point in whining while we wait to get to our destination...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, there's Dad!
I think he's all finished.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, one last time. Do you have everything you need?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yup!
I mean, worst case scenario, we can still perform as long as we're physically there♪

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hehe. True...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If you say so... Anyway, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Kohane, An & Toya
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes.
Ski Resort

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
We had a full day on the slopes and even had a snowball fight! I couldn't be more satisfied!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Skiing was challenging, but very fun and rewarding.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Again, Akito, Shiraishi, thank you for teaching us. You too for practicing with me, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: There's no need to thank us.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. Any slope other than the bunny slopes would have been too challenging for me, so I'm glad you were there to ski with me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, talk about a busy couple of days...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We got up early, stopped by a bunch of rest areas, got here, hit the slopes, put on a performance and hit the slopes again...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And we got to be a part of the show Tsukasa and his troupe put on.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. I sort of couldn't believe it when I saw that they were performing here!
“What a wonderfully snowy village!”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm? That voice...
But there's no reason for him to be...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No... Based on my experience, he appears when you least expect it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I knew it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I still don't understand how they can be everywhere at once.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! You really do run into them a lot, huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Seeing their show at the beginning of the new year was very invigorating.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, it was! On top of that, we also smiled and laughed so much! I have a really good feeling about this coming year!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Same. Talk about a “cool” way to start off the year! You know, because we're at a snowy ski resort?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Nice one, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, you two...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, I agree. This does seem like the start of a good year. I mean, you don't get many chances to perform in the great outdoors like this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, it's closed during winter, but there's apparently a hiking trail.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I saw a sign for it at the lodge. The leaves are supposed to be beautiful during the fall.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! There were some pictures of the leaves during fall on display at the entrance.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I saw those too. They were so pretty that I ended up asking who took them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Not where they were taken?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I saw that photo as well and found myself wanting to see the real thing...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me too! That trail does sound like fun!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, let's hope they invite us back around that time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. I might just ask the owner now!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Our show went really well, so I've got a really good feeling!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If we do get another opportunity, it could be nice to visit some more rest areas.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I'd like to try that foot bath again since it felt so nice.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Totally! It felt so good that I almost fell asleep!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You didn't almost fall asleep. You were pretty much asleep the whole time there.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And if we're gonna do this again, I wanna check out that shop with the “ultimate” melon buns.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, you seemed very interested in trying them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, the ones with ice cream sandwiched between them? I wanna go too! They looked so good!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I've had something similar at a different place, but it really was something else.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, you've had something like it before? And you wanna try it again?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, each shop makes it differently.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. We have so much to look forward to.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. If we do get to go on another trip, let's try to have just as much fun as we did this time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, sounds good.
Main Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane, are you free tomorrow?
You too, Akito, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I don't have any animal caretaker committee duties to do tomorrow, so I was planning on going home early to practice somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I have library committee business to take care of tomorrow... But I may be able to leave early if I tell them what's going on.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm free too. I don't have work tomorrow, so my plan was to go train somewhere.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, let's all go to Crawl Green!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What? To Crawl Green...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Crawl Green... I haven't been there since...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Not too long ago, just going there would've been enough to make me so nervous that I'd've frozen up or lost control of my voice...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But now...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Apologies for the wait, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey.
You all done with committee stuff?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that's all settled. And I'd already told the seniors that I had a prior engagement.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, you said that you wanted to do something before we headed to Crawl Green...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Waiting around twiddling our thumbs seems like a waste of time, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, wanna sing for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Just the two of us...?
It's been quite a while.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, it's just...
You seem at ease with yourself...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's because I am. I feel fine.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I have you guys, Ken and Taiga to thank for that.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's sing.
Starting with our usual when we were still the BAD DOGS.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, let's begin.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He's singing with quite a bit of power. I have to think he's more than just fine...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (So, why don't I also...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's been a while since we sang this together, but he's rock solid... No, wait...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He sounds like he's having a lot of fun!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Did he just improvise that part? Well played...)

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Hey, aren't they from Vivid BAD SQUAD?!

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's the BAD DOGS!
These days, it's pretty rare to see just the two of them singing!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I was thinking that we'd do a light session, but we both ended up going all out.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I blame you for sprinting from the start. I had no choice but to try to keep up...

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line:
Way to go, BAD DOGS!
That was awesome!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, thanks!

rows.Speaker: Passersby
rows.Line: It's been forever since you guys last sang on the street! Don't stop now!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry, but we gotta be somewhere after this. But if you wanna hear us sing that much...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Come to our third event!
At Crawl Green!

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: C-Crawl Green?!

rows.Speaker: Passersby
rows.Line:
What?! There?!
No way! I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're meeting with the owner today, so we promise to let you guys know once we have more details.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, we should go...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I feel a little better now...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? About what?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: About going to Crawl Green. You said that you wanted to do something before we went there, so it seemed like you had something on your mind...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Of course I had something on my mind.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
This is my chance to redeem myself.
I need to do everything I can do to make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we need to make sure our meeting goes well first. So, Toya, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's.
Crawl Green
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, do we all have our things?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm all set!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh...?
This drink's only half-finished. Whose could it be...?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Oh, thanks! That's mine!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Then, let's start heading out.

rows.Speaker: EVER Member
rows.Line: The after party's at Weekend Garage like usual, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, Ken said he'd have a spread ready for us.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Then, we should head over while everything's still warm. But before we do, we should thank the owner.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I already did that. I bumped into him when I went outside for some air just now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Oh, I was hoping to go with either Tono or An when they went...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: However, what happened that day helped strengthen my resolve. So, I... I vow to not let the crowd down like that again.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, I'll be expecting to see some good results from you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I hope I managed to achieve some results this time...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(No, our event went great...
And I was able to sing better than I usually do.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(But I didn't do that by myself...
Kohane definitely pulled us all forward...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Along with the owner wanting to see “good results”...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Akito? Is everything okay?
The others have already left.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Yeah, um...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sorry, Toya...
You go ahead with everyone to Weekend Garage. Tell the others that I'll be running a little late.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay...
Let me know if anything comes up.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Will do.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Now then...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sir...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
Ah, it's you.
Nice work today.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
So, what bring you here...?
I thought you and your friends were having an after party. Are you not going?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No, I'll attend later.
But before I do...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you for today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I thought I owed you that much.
Anyway, I'll be...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
Ah, just one second.
I already told An this, but I'd like to tell you as well.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Tell me what...?

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: You put on a good event.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: I can't say that you were able to produce the same sort of noise and energy that RADder did during their debut event...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: But you definitely created a good atmosphere.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: You were finally able to produce some good results, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: In fairness, I may be seeing RADder's debut event through rose-colored glasses. But I still put that on top...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Still, I'll be looking forward to hearing more about you and your friends.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you. We promise to surpass Ken... We're definitely going to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Yes, I'll be looking forward to that moment.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you!
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Akito, what took you so long?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Have you all been waiting for me?
You know you guys could've just gone ahead without me, right...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: We're a team, so we weren't about to leave you behind.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Hahaha! You hear that, Shinonome? That's coming from the guy who's always going off and doing stuff on his own!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Anyway, don't be so standoffish with us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, were you able to speak with the owner...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I managed to say what I wanted, and I even got to hear something nice in return.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm curious as to what he told you, but let's head over to my place first...!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm totally starved!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go.
Lunch break
Kamiyama High School - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Akito, let's go grab some food!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Won't he be having lunch with his partner like usual? Or who knows, he could even have an appointment with Tenma?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
That's zero for two.
Anyway, I'm gonna go get some air...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's been a few days since then, but I still can't get what happened out of my head...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I thought I'd processed it already...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: As you all are now, even if you spend your whole lives trying, you'll never surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I don't doubt that you'll keep getting better. Even if there's a massive skill gap between me and the rest of you, your chances of reaching my level won't be zero.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: But I'm talking about what's in here. Your heart.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: RAD WEEKEND was Nagi Kotaki's final event. It was meant to be my little sister's swan song.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: She found out she was sick and had just months to live, and she decided to use what little time she had left to put on one last event in this neighborhood.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: That was RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That night was her last event...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I can't believe it...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I still remember it like it happened yesterday. The way she sang lit this giant bonfire inside of me.)

rows.Speaker: Akito

rows.Line: You might actually have what it takes to become just like him. But it's gonna be tough... Really tough.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Credit where credit's due...

rows.Line: Honestly, you probably sounded better than I did that night.

rows.Line:
Argh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(But I can't stop now...

rows.Speaker: Akito

rows.Line:

Would you like one?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay then.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You have a few options to choose from.
Tuna salad, plum, bonito, salmon...

rows.Speaker: Akito

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, is there something on your mind?

rows.Line: Kinda. I was just thinking about RAD WEEKEND, what Taiga said to us and all that other stuff... I can't get it out of my head...

Me neither...

Interesting...
How did you know?

rows.Line: Because I felt the same way.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Line: Coming up against walls and overcoming them has become pretty normal for us as a team.

Same.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You two should go hide somewhere. I have to keep walking.

rows.Line: Seriously?! Why are you being so reckless?!

rows.Line: It's just that... I can hear something calling out from inside me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's saying, “Keep going, don't stop!”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If I don't, then...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'll...lose something precious to me, and myself along with it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's how it feels.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's why we're here—to support you! So you can keep going!

rows.Line: We want to help all of you make your dreams come true.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We promised to be there for you no matter what until the very day you surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Gargh! I can't see!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Don't worry! We can pull through if we stick together!

rows.Line: She's right, Akito! You don't have to face it alone!

rows.Speaker: Akito

There's no way we'll be able to surpass RAD WEEKEND without you!
So if something's bothering you, ask us for help!
Let's sing as a team, Shinonome!
As long as we're together, we'll be able to surpass RAD WEEKEND!

This isn't just your dream.

rows.Line: Urgh... My entire body's caked in sand.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Rin, Len, I'm sorry for dragging you into this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I remember everything now.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I remember that you've always been there to support us. Not to mention how you wouldn't stop pestering me to show you the video of our third event.

rows.Line: Hurray!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Ah, Akito, you're here pretty early today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I figured no other customers would be here right after you opened...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Which probably means that you wanted to talk to me...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes, um... If it's alright with you...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: A kid like you doesn't need to put on a face for me. Anyway, come on in.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Alright, here's your usual coffee.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: So, what is it that you wanted to talk to me about...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: There's something I needed to ask you...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: After we battled against Tono and lost that one time, I came here to apologize...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: For not taking your advice and trying to do everything on my own.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yeah, I remember.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Do you also remember what you said to me...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I do...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: RAD WEEKEND, huh...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Goals and ideals are things that can give people purpose, but also mislead them.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: A lot of people end up seeing the past, their own pasts especially, through rose-colored glasses.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Without even realizing it, we all sort of exaggerate the truth and detach ourselves from reality.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm not sure what you're trying to say.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll understand in time...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: For now, just make sure to cherish your friends. They seemed very worried about you over what happened.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We know the truth behind RAD WEEKEND now...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, if possible, I'd like it if you could tell me what you meant that time...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Though, I have a feeling you already know the answer to that question.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Sorry, I wasn't trying to be unforthcoming or anything...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: A part of me knew you'd return to ask me about what I said someday. So, please feel free to speak your mind.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: When you said how goals and ideals can mislead people, were you actually talking about Nagi and RAD WEEKEND?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: What you youngsters saw and what's become a part of the fabric of this town... They're the same thing, but also not.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Unless you know the secret behind that event, and understand all the emotions we felt... You and your team won't be able to surpass it.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: We knew that, but we still decided to pass the torch on to the next generation.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: There's a huge gap between those who know the truth and those who don't.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I think a part of Taiga was really bothered by how things became so distorted.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: So, as much as I don't like how he went about things, I believe that was his way of telling you all the truth...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, you were worried about RAD WEEKEND being called such a legendary event because...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Nagi's passing, our choices, our ruse...
None of that is anything to be glorified.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I have a much better understanding now...

rows.Line: Thank you for telling me all this, Ken.

rows.Line: Sounds like you got the answer you were looking for.

rows.Speaker: Akito
