rows.Line: Do you have any particular fabrics or designs in mind, or any colors or anything? We have a fairly wide selection here.

rows.Speaker: Male Customer
rows.Line: Oh, I'm not really the fashion-conscious type... The clothes I usually get sort of all look the same, you know?

rows.Speaker: Male Customer
rows.Line: So, could you help me pick out an outfit?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Of course. Then...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Based on what he's wearing now, I doubt he'd usually go for clothing with printed patterns. But he also said he wants something different from his usual repertoire...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
How about something with a patterned inner lining?
We also have some interesting shirts that aren't too flashy.

rows.Speaker: Male Customer
rows.Line: You do?! Then, I'd like to try both of those!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you very much. I'll bring them over now.
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Nice work today, Akito.
Your work ethic and customer service skills are always a huge help around here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you very much...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Um, so...
Do you have a minute to talk?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Oh, that's right! You asked earlier if we could chat! Now should be fine since we don't have any customers at the moment.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, I need to leave this job.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Would you mind telling me why...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I need to invest more time into practicing.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: I'd heard rumors that you and your friends battled against Taiga...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: And how you heard about what happened to Nagi...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, you also knew what RAD WEEKEND was actually about...?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry.
I wish I could've told you...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm not sure what An would say, but I won't hold that against you...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I want to say that I understand just how big an influence Nagi had on this town.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Our dream hasn't changed.
We're going to find a way to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
...!
Right...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: You said that you need more time to practice. Do you and your team already have a plan in mind?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, not yet... But we also need time to figure that out, which is why I'm doing this now...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Understood.
Then, this can be your last day.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What?
Wait, I thought I had to give you a few days.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Under normal circumstances. But I'm making a special exception as your manager.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Yes... This may be shameless of me to say, but I am rooting for you guys...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Boss...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We absolutely promise to put on an event that surpasses RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you for letting me work here.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Thank you for being such a wonderful employee. It was fun while it lasted. Be sure to drop by as a customer from time to time, okay?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I will!
Nighttime
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm so tired...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: My English grammar is coming along, but I still can't remember the vocab I need.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
The supplementary classes are nearly over...
At this rate, am I actually gonna pass...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I've gotta improve a little by tomorrow. I wanna be able to answer at least fifty—no, forty—percent of the questions.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'll go over what Toya and the others taught me while it's still fresh.
Shinonome Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, it's you. Welcome home.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What are you doing up at this hour?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What do you mean, what am I doing? I'm eating sweets. Look, I bought these since they're so cute.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What are they? Donuts?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yep. They were on sale by the station. They were super cheap so I bought a whole bunch.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But there's none for you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, alright. I wasn't expecting any anyway.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: More importantly, you're in supplementary classes, right? And you might get held back? Are you gonna be okay?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How do you know about that?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are you that surprised? You were right here telling Mom about it the other day.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If you don't wanna get held back, wouldn't it be wise to study right now?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't need you to tell me that. I was about to go study.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh. Well, good luck with that.
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm beat...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's so much harder to study in my room than at school...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'll grab something to drink and give it one more hour.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? There's one of those donuts left over?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's her problem? Making a point of saying, “None for you,” then not even finishing them.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Akito, you're awake?
Are you hungry?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, I'm just getting a drink. I'm probably gonna make some coffee.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: At this hour? You won't sleep a wink.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I can't sleep right now. I still need to study.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: I see. Well, if you're sure, then wait there and I'll make it for you.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Oh, and eat that donut.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No way, Ena'll kill me if I do.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: That one's for you, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? For me?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Yes. Earlier, Ena said...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks for dinner.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: You're welcome. Leave the dishes to soak, will you?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Hm? There's one of those donuts you bought left over. It's only a little one, so why don't you just finish them off?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, it's okay. That one's for Akito.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You need sugar when you're studying right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't know how long he's going to keep at it, but can you give it to him if he comes downstairs?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ena...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Well, I'm sure she was being thoughtful in her own way. Make sure you say thank you to her tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What a weirdo. What's next? Snow in summer?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's really good.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, time for one last push...!
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, once again...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Akito! An! Congratulations on making it into second year!

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Toya
rows.Line: Congratulations!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I didn't feel confident when we started, but we got through it in the end.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You both worked so hard. Well done.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You too, Toya! You were working hard teaching them, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. However, it wasn't just me. I got help from someone I know in the year above, which was a big help.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hey, so what were your study sessions like?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Was Toya all serious, like, “You can't leave this room until you answer these questions!”?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, so I heard they did a bunch of fun stuff, like playing games to decide who had to go buy snacks or swapping up who was teaching what.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: A study session like that sounds really fun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! I know we were being a burden by getting into that mess in the first place, but it really was fun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But, wait... Len, how do you know so much about our study sessions?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, I... Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I told him about it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You did?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I came here to study a few times while we had the supplementary classes. Wanted to change things up a bit.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Akito stayed up late here working hard.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You did?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If you'd told me, I would have come to help.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, you were already doing more than enough for me at school.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Besides, I wanted to review what you'd already taught me that day, not learn new stuff.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wait, what? I wish I could've helped out too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me and Rin agreed not to tell you or KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yep. We didn't want any disruption when Akito was trying to focus.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Whaaat?! That's so mean! KAITO, sure. But why me?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I was about to say the same thing! Why didn't you tell me?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You probably have your reputations to blame for that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ahaha... But actually, I understand how you feel, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: When An told me all about the study sessions, I was a little jealous.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Exactly! See, MEIKO and everyone were being mean!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: By the way, Akito, how did you study?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How did I study...? I mostly looked over my notes and worked through worksheets...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And sometimes I taught Len some things when I wanted a change of pace.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, teaching something to someone else can help you learn it, can't it?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. There were some questions on the test that I could answer because I remembered teaching Len about them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Nice assist there, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'll let you teach me again anytime!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What do you sound all high and mighty for? Still, I have to admit it was helpful.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you to you too, MEIKO, for all the coffee and sweets.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're very welcome. I'm glad I could help.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Now then, Akito! An! Now that you've secured your places in second year, what are your ambitions for the next twelve months?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ooh, yeah! I wanna know too! Your grades are gonna be fine from now on, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, hmm...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Next year...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Next year, I'm going to avoid failing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Surely you could aim to achieve above-average grades?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Uh... Well...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: W-We'll give it shot...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ahaha...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Well, I'm sure you've learned your lesson and will be consistently hardworking students from now on.
One day, during lunch
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Those two never change...
Don't they ever run out of things to talk about during lunch?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I mean, they are partners.
I'm guessing they can talk about anything.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Is that how that works...?
The next day - Lunch break

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, would you like to get lunch?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: We're second-years now, but this still plays out the same.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Hang on. Don't tell me you're not friends with anyone in your own class.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Then what am I supposed to call you guys? But I'll be happy to leave if that's what you want.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Wait, what?!
I thought we were besties!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Fine, leave. We didn't want you anyway.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Toya, as a former classmate, here's a friendly piece of advice. You're a socially awkward guy, so you should be talking with people from your own class more than someone like Akito here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you, but I should be fine.
I've been able to put into practice all my experiences with you from last year.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Aw, shucks, that's a nice thing to say about us!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, let's go.
A few days later - Lunch break
Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya, you there?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
He is indeed♪
You guys really are inseparable.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You decided to show up today...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: To be fair, I just got here a second ago!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, Toya and I were just having a friendly chat as classmates♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! You look totally disinterested.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I doubt Akito would be all that interested in talking about books with us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Books? Like novels?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. We were just discussing the story that this one anime Akiyama likes is based on.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Apparently, the creator of the source material for this anime I'm hooked on lately was really influenced by mystery novels!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And both the original and the show have all these little nods to the genre scattered throughout it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which is why I decided to ask Toya about it since he likes mystery novels.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ah, still no interest, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't read novels or watch much anime...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Personally, I'm surprised to hear that, considering you were born in the home of anime.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, we gotta get to the school store before they run out of the good stuff.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, you got any plans...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm? For what?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: For lunch. Did you eat already?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No. I didn't eat anything because I thought I'd make it in time for lunch.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I'd rather not ruin you guys' fun.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, then, have fun eating alone.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, wait! I'm sorry!
That was a joke!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let me have lunch with you guys! Please!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You couldn't just say that right away?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, Li'l Bro, your buttons are just too much fun to press♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's it. We're going without you...
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Classmates A & B
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, what's with the synchronized sighing...?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Can't you tell that we're feeling depressed?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Yeah.
If only there were someone to listen to what's bothering us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Fine, I'll bite...
What happened?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Seriously, what happened?!
How did I only grow three millimeters this past year?!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: They told me that I shrank two centimeters! I'm supposed to be a growing teenager!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, you're talking about when we got our measurements taken earlier?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Wait, why do you sound so calm...?
Please don't say that you grew...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Two centimeters.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, don't give me those looks...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I mean, I was surprised too.
But we're only talking about two centimeters here.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Only two centimeters?!
I shrank two centimeters! That puts me under 170!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Yeah, there's a huge difference between being above and below that number...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ah... Yeah, that is a huge difference.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Don't patronize us!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Akito! Gimme your legs...!
No, your torso! Five centimeters! That's all I ask!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Not happening...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Akito, are you there?
About practice after school...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry, was I interrupting...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Eh, kinda, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Come to think of it, did your class also just get measurements taken? What was your height?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My height? I grew a centimeter.

rows.Speaker: Classmates A & B
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
How is this fair?!
It's like only the tall ones get to keep growing!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I'm really starting to reconsider our relationship!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
No, that was a joke!
I didn't mean what I just said! Don't take it seriously!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Don't mind them. They're just griping about not growing as much as they'd hoped.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Guh...!
You're right, but this is still really frustrating...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's all true!
Sorry, Toya, you've done nothing wrong...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: For a second there, I was worried that I'd overstepped a boundary and said or done something to offend you...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Argh...!
M-My poor heart...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I vaguely remember whining about my height and shoe size when I was still playing soccer...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Height I understand...
But why your shoe size?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Haven't you ever heard about how people with big feet are supposed to grow tall?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I have...
But that apparently has no scientific basis.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I didn't believe it either when I saw someone say that on TV.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: No, big feet means being able to support a large body! It's a sign that someone's ready to grow, right?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I thought the same thing.
But it's apparently normal to stop growing after your voice changes.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: No, that doesn't make any sense. You're still growing! Explain that!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Don't ask me...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, if you wanna grow taller, then why don't you make some changes to your current lifestyle? Staying up late playing video games probably isn't helping.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Urgh... I didn't come here to be lectured.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, Toya, sorry...
You were asking about practice after school, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
I'd forgotten how much fun it was to talk with everyone like this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Mind if I stop by during the next break? We can talk about practice then.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, I'll be waiting.
WEEKEND GARAGE

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Akito, let's take a break here...
You're going to lose your voice at this rate.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Here, have some water.
Try to cool yourself down a little.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, thank you...
Bottoms up.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Phew...
Thank you. I feel a little better now.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Okay.
That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Sorry for only being able to offer you water. Under normal circumstances, I'd be making you some coffee while you took a break...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, I really appreciate this...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Ken's coffee...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (We used to drink coffee, have food and throw after-parties here...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Akito...?
You there?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, um... Sorry.
It's nothing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I was just remembering what this place was like when it was still open. Like where the tables used to be and stuff like that.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
I see.
As the owner, I couldn't be happier hearing a valued customer say that.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Akito, you're one of my oldest customers. You came when I first opened up shop, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, yes... I had heard the rumors about KEN from RADder opening his own business.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Heh, that takes me back.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Me too...
That day, I remember...
A few years earlier

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Hey, welcome.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
(Whoa, it's really KEN...
And he's right in front of me...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Sorry, all the tables are full...
Is the counter okay?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Oh, um... Yes!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Alright, let me know when you're ready to order.

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: Ken! Can we get another pizza and some refills?!

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: Us too! Give us everything you've got!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Hey, aren't you guys going a little overboard...?

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line:
Don't say that!
We're all here to celebrate!

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: Yeah! I mean, you started your own business? How cool is that? You expect us not to celebrate?!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I appreciate it, but try to celebrate responsibly...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Sorry about them, kid.
They're usually not as raucous.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
N-No, that's okay...
I didn't realize you'd be so busy.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Yeah, I've been on my feet the entire day. But it's nice to see that business is off to a good start.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
I see...
Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
K-KEN...?
Congratulations on your grand opening...!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Hey, I really appreciate that.
As thanks, have a drink on me.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Of course.
Call me over when you know what you want.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
O-Okay!
Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You were so nervous and anxious that I couldn't help but smile. You weren't the person I expected from the rumors I heard.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Wait, what...?!
Please don't make fun of me like that!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, what rumors...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Oh.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I remember people talking about “this Akito Shinonome kid who's been picking fights with everyone”...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I was surprised to find out that kid who came into my shop was you. You were so quiet and kept looking at the floor. I figured you must be the type to change gears easily.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
C-Cut me some slack...!
How was I supposed to act in front of my hero...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Haha. Thanks for calling me that.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I'm sorry for pushing your buttons, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I can't offer much, but come back for another free drink when all this is over and I've opened this place back up.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I will...!
Vivid Street
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musician
rows.Line:
Oh, hey, look!
Isn't that...Shinonome?

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musician
rows.Line: Oh, the guy everyone's been talking about? I heard he put on a really amazing street performance the other day...

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musician
rows.Line:
Yeah, it was off the hook!
He was like an earthquake or something!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Things do feel a little different around here now. Nothing like how they were after we lost to Taiga...)

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musician
rows.Line: They're gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND at COL, right?

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musician
rows.Line:
They are?
But I thought COL closed down.

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musician
rows.Line: Is the owner helping them out in some way?

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musician
rows.Line: I haven't felt this excited in such a long time. We might get to see something really special again...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Everyone's excited. They have high expectations of us now...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Which means I accomplished my objective...)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro's Friend
rows.Line: Oh! Hey, Akito!
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Aren't you...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, you hang out with Mita a lot.
I haven't seen you in forever. What's up?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro's Friend
rows.Line: So, about that street performance you put on the other day... I was there! I was getting ready for an event, so I only got to watch a little...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro's Friend
rows.Line:
But I couldn't believe what I saw!
The way you sang made my jaw drop!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro's Friend
rows.Line: Also... I wanted to thank you for helping Mita!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro's Friend
rows.Line: Your performance gave him the push he needed to start singing again. I really couldn't be happier.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro's Friend
rows.Line: After you guys lost to Taiga and all those rumors started going around... Let's just say he wasn't in a good place.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Yeah, he really didn't look good when I saw him that time...)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro's Friend
rows.Line:
But he's such a good singer.
It'd be a waste for him to not put his talent to use, right?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro's Friend
rows.Line: I kept inviting him to perform in some events, but he just didn't feel up to it...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro's Friend
rows.Line: But you, Akito... You managed to pull him back up on his feet with just one song. I still can't believe it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (With one song...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No...
I don't deserve all the credit.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro's Friend
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Mita isn't the kind of guy who gives up easily. We kept singing with him because we believed that about him.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: There was probably nothing we could've done if he had already decided to up and leave town...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But he was still here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He probably stayed because he felt that he had some unfinished business as a musician. But not only that, the fact that you kept inviting him to perform must have also helped.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, we should be thanking you.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro's Friend
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro's Friend
rows.Line:
I really hope you guys succeed!
I wanna see you guys surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, we will!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You better be ready.
We're gonna be the ones to surpass RAD WEEKEND! No one else!
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Okay, why don't we take a break here?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: The event in Yokohama starts this evening. We'll be leaving at three, so do whatever you want until then.

rows.Speaker: Kohane, An, Akito & Toya
rows.Line: Got it!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: By the way, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
It's your birthday, right?
Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Try to loosen up a little and relax for today. It's a special occasion.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh... Yes, I will.
Thank you.
se_walk_men_004_1

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
We've been singing all morning, so I'm already starving! Dad did say to relax, so let's find a place to eat!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Since we have the time, why not?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But where? If we're looking for a place we can chill...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Would it be alright for me to choose? There's somewhere I'd like to go...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Somewhere you wanna go...?
Diner

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You...wanted to go to a diner?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry, would you prefer somewhere else?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, that's not what I'm getting at. I was just kinda surprised, is all.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. Thank goodness.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hahaha. But hey, sometimes you just feel like diner food, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, I think I know what you mean.
Um, where's the menu...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Here.
Let's get to ordering.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
Thank you for waiting!
Here is your cake.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Cake?
Sorry, we haven't ordered ye—
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ta-da!
We were the ones who ordered it♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You two...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, Li'l Bro...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki & Ena
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And thanks for bringing Li'l Bro here, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No problem. More importantly, please sit. We'll shift over.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Pardon me!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya, you... I wondered what made you suddenly wanna go to a diner. So this was why.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akiyama contacted me yesterday asking for my help with this surprise. I apologize for somewhat deceiving you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The cheesecake here is to die for, so I thought it'd be great for a surprise!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I actually invited Rui and Tsukasa too. But unfortunately, they said they already had something going on today.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Forgive me, Akito!
We have plans that we cannot reschedule on that day...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But allow us to make it up to you next week by putting on an exceptional show for your birthday! You won't be disappointed!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: ...is what he told me to tell you. He was super pumped about it♪

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
A show by Tsukasa and his troupe...
Isn't that great, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Spare me, please...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, I hope you're fine with just us today♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Akiyama. We haven't ordered yet, so if there's anything you'd like...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks, Kohane!
Let's see that menu!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, why are you here too?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I'm accompanying Mizuki.
I went out of my way for this, you should be grateful.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's not like I asked you to.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? You're so rude.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. You two really are close.

rows.Speaker: Akito & Ena
rows.Line: No, we're not.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: See, you were even in sync. Just two peas in a pod!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, alright. Let's make peace now!
You guys have practice after this, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We'll be going to a live house in Yokohama, so we're supposed to meet up at around three.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yikes! We don't have a lot of time...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay then, let's hurry up and order!
Time flies by when you're having fun and all♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah.
And after you've had your fun, give your practice what you've got.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We've gotta knock it out of the park at the event once we've recharged.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, let's get to ordering. What did you guys want?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Since Ena and Akiyama are joining us, why don't we order something we can all share?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, then how about pizza? Or maybe some French fries too?
Shinonome Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm back.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Oh, welcome home, Akito. Ena and I have already started dinner.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Still, what perfect timing. We were just talking about you. So you and Ena were together earlier today?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Uh... Yeah, we were...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? What kind of reply was that?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The cheesecake tasted good, did it not?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, yeah. It was good...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, Ena. She's been worried about you since you've been practicing until late recently, and—

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mom! Why are you telling him that?!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: What's the problem? You never would've told him yourself.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Well, you heard her.
Working hard is great and all, but make sure to take breaks once in a while too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: ...Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
So... How did your event go?
It was like a battle or something, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah... We managed to win.
The competition there was really fierce, so it was a close match.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh... Guess you did alright.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. After getting a breather at lunch, it felt like I was able to face things a little calmer...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, what I'm trying to say is... Thanks for today.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Alright then, I expect you to return the favor.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Return the favor?
So it wasn't like you wanted to celebrate after all.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Alright, that's enough. Ena, hurry up and eat your dinner. Akito, go take a bath, it's already heated up for you.

rows.Speaker: Akito & Ena
rows.Line: Okay...
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I never would've expected Ena to say something like that...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Akito!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What the—? MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Sorry for startling you like that. Are you free right now?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Why do you ask?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Would you mind coming to SEKAI for a bit? We wanted to celebrate your birthday.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I contacted Toya and the others already. If you could all come together, that would be great!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure thing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Thank you. See you later!>
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, this is mean!
Why is everyone ganging up on me?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's 'cause you blurted out how weak your cards were as soon as you got them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, An the beggar has to give Akito two strong cards since he's the president!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yup♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: *Groan*

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: C'mon, hurry up. You just gotta pick the two strongest ones. Shouldn't be hard.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, shut it! This is going to be the last time, got it?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hahaha♪
This game tournament is so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It is. We don't usually play games like this together. It's quite nice.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. I was surprised when you guys suddenly announced we'd be doing a tournament, but I guess it might be fun every now and then.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Alright, then let's have fun until we're ready to pass out tonight!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! So let's move on to the next round!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, three 10s.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Akito's on a roll.
I think it's about time we do “that”.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think so too. Rin, Len, could you help me?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? H-Help?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, that's against the rules!
It ain't that kind of game!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wow. They worked together seamlessly.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I was wondering what those three were doing all sneakily recently. Seems like they were practicing that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh... I won! I became president!
Thank you, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm beat! We got so into it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I can't believe you guys teamed up to stir things up...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You won quite a bit, and it looked like you were having fun! I, on the other hand...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You ended up being the beggar for most of the game...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Alright, let's move on to the next game!
That way, An has a chance to redeem herself!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Next game? How many did you guys prepare?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um... Around ten? We figured we could keep playing for hours that way!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yeah! The night is still young♪
Even if the date changes, your birthday's not over until we're knocked out!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
That's news to me.
Also, I can't stay too late since I've got another early morning tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Now that I think about it, even though I had practice this morning... I don't feel tired at all.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Actually, the fatigue probably disappeared while I was having fun.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I guess breaks are important.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: At this rate... I should be able to go even further tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hm? Did you say something?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nah, it's nothing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Anyway, are we playing or not?
Let's keep the fun going.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe, that's more like it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm winning the next game too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Akito!
You've always had it together, so I guess there isn't any need to worry...but make sure not to overdo it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Happy birthday.
That should be enough, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, c'mon! You even prepared a gift and everything. Can't you put a little more heart into it?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? I just happened to come across it... Besides, you were the one who suggested it as a good gift.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No no no, you had it picked out and I just said it was a good choice! Anyway, we got you lozenges! This'll overlap with what Airi said, but remember to take care of yourself♪

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Mizuki and Ena have been trying to find a good spot for your surprise for a while. Judging by the looks on their faces, it seems like everything went well. Happy birthday, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday. The way you sing is so cool, Akito. I'm looking forward to the next time I get to hear you sing.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Akito! How did you like the show we performed for you at school?! I'm quite proud of how it went myself, but we'd be happy to perform it again if you wish!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! We'll perform as many shows as we need until you can be all smiles, Akito☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. If we were to perform it once more, then I'd like to make more use of the classroom. Perhaps it's time to give the mechanism I set up in the 2-A classroom last year another whirl.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Absolutely not! We are not doing it in our classroom!
*Sigh*
Sorry about that, Shinonome. Um... Once again, happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shinonome. It was super fun eating cake and playing games with everyone! Let's do our best today too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I can't believe I kept losing...
Next time, I'm definitely gonna win!
Anyway, looking forward to more training with you!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Akito. Your singing has given me strength more times than I can count. Let's keep putting everything into our singing as partners and teammates.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks for doing all this for me today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right now, all of us are doing what we need to do to surpass RAD WEEKEND, and our daily practices are tougher than ever. To the point that I haven't been stopping to catch my breath.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's why I'm grateful for my friends, Ken, my family... And also you guys. It means a lot to have people supporting me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'll be expressing my thanks through my singing, so... I hope you'll keep watching.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, see you later.
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Really...?
Your class is making a film?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, we are.
Something about making the most of our youth or whatever...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I do agree with that.
Making a film as a class certainly sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, what kinda film are you making? Have you guys already decided?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup! An action film!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, action! That sounds wonderful!
What's the story going to be like?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, it's a post-apocalyptic setting...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: P-Post-apocalyptic...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Everyone's struggling to get enough food to eat, and these Dark Cooks go around hoarding everything for themselves!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's where the Wandering Cook comes in.
He fights against the Dark Cooks to bring delicious food to all those who really need it!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I see...
That's quite a unique plot.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I think it's kinda cool...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A wandering hero battling against evildoers is romantic to say the least!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, Akito, Shiraishi, how will you be assisting?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're both gonna be acting in it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'll be the girl who the Wandering Cook tries to save! And can you guess who Akito's playing...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: He's the lead!

rows.Speaker: Luka, Rin & Len
rows.Line: Wh-Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: H-He's the lead...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why are you guys making a fuss about it...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Of course we are!
Getting to be the lead is a huge deal!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Actually, Akito, I think you're going to make for a wonderful hero.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree!
Especially since you have more guts than the average person, and a straightforward personality!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You think so...?
I'm still having trouble imagining myself as him...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, I didn't really have a choice when it came to who I'd be playing...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, one of our classmates who can do stunts was originally supposed to be the lead, but it turns out that acting isn't really his thing...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He and I are the same height and build, so we decided that I'll play the lead while he does all the stunts.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. Now we understand.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I think it's good that you get to be the hero now! I mean, you're probably pretty good at acting...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, because of how he acts politely around others...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, exactly!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: C'mon, guys...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I do agree that you seem like a different person in those situations.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, that's just me minding my manners...
What does that have to do with acting?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Haha♪
By the way, An, how do you feel about your acting chops?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Me? I dunno, but I should be fine!
I was the lead for a school play this one time when I was little!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Really...?!
That's so cool, An!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm so bad at acting. I always get so nervous.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: How about you, Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well, I remember doing a couple shows with Tsukasa when I was little...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I recall enjoying myself, but... I'm not sure about my acting skills either.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I see.
But having fun is still probably the most important thing, yes?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
She's right!
So, we hope you two have lots of fun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We will!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Having fun is important, but we should also do our best to make our film good.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! You gotta beat up as many Dark Cooks as you can, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Uh, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, since we're doing this, we should do our best.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Agreed!
After school
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (With Soda out, I have to start doing my own stunts...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'm not nearly as good as him, but I've gotta do what I can.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Akito, the cast's all here!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay. Then, let's start discussing the stunts for the final showdown. Mind starting us off with any thoughts you have?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The toughest part of this scene is probably when you have to take on all three goons and deal with them one after another...

rows.Speaker: Nene

rows.Line: Ta-da! Does this cake look familiar?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Is this...a cheesecake?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wow, it looks delicious!
Did you make this, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I did! Well, MEIKO helped me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I made the sour cream from scratch, and getting the cream cheese to fold in without lumps was hard. I worked for this, you know?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sour cream from scratch...
Hey, wait a minute.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Is this... Ken's cheesecake?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ding ding ding! It's my Dad's recipe.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm impressed, Akito. How did you know?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's just that I remember Ken saying his place's cheesecake uses handmade sour cream.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I didn't think it could be, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You've always loved Dad's cheesecake, right? That's why I asked him for the recipe and gave it a shot!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We know that flavor means a lot to you, so An and I worked very hard to recreate it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But, you know... It'd be a bit boring to just let you have it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Let's sing for it. You versus me.
If you win, you can have the whole thing all to yourself.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, wasn't the whole point of bugging Ken and MEIKO to help you with this for me to eat it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh, I don't recall ever saying that.
Well, we don't have to, if you're scared you're going to lose.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, very original.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Alright, I'll bite. Explain your rules.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The rules are simple. We both sing, and whoever gets the room more hyped is the winner. Sound fair?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, fine.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, you guys.
You heard her, you're judging.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wait, you're singing?
Let us sing, too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! It's not fair that only you and An get to sing. And the winner gets the whole cheesecake, too?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, come on. If everyone gets involved, who's going to decide who the winner is?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It'll be fine. We'll all be able to tell while we're singing anyway... And either way, I want to get in on this too♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I swear, Luka...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But it's more like a party if we all sing together, right? And I just so happen to have the perfect track.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hey, nice. Give us something with a good beat, okay?
Kohane, Toya, are you two in?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I would like to join. As his partner, I can't leave Akito to sing on his own.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And... If I win, I can give Akito the cheesecake as a present.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Then sure, I'll sing too.
The cake does look good...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I also think that all of us singing together will feel even more like a celebration for Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I feel like you're all totally losing the plot here. Don't blame me if this ends up in chaos.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright. Let's do this!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes.
Of course!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Mm, that really felt good!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So much for a birthday, huh? That was just what we do every day.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But hey, I guess that's just like us.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And you looked like you were having fun the whole time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, who won in the end?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hmm, I thought we'd be able to tell while we were singing... But I was having so much fun, I totally forgot about the contest♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
See, what did I say?
But it's true, it was hard to tell. Everyone's singing melded together as one.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, that answers that, then. Go grab me a knife and enough plates for everyone.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, you're not planning to keep it all to yourself?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why would I do that? The contest's a wash anyway. And besides...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It'd be a waste to hog a cake that looks this good.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I got you. One sec!
se_run_women_004_1

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, be careful not to trip.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (This cheesecake gets me thinking... These guys really are always looking out for me.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (After RAD BLAST, a lot of stuff has changed for all of us...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But I get the feeling they'll always be here, just like this.)
se_walk_women_004_1

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Akito! I got the plates and serving knife!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An, let me help you with that! We can split them up.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then I'll help MEIKO and the others get fresh drinks made for everyone. You must all be thirsty after all that singing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, thanks. I'll have the cake cut in a flash, so take the plates and pass 'em down.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Akito! Once again, happy birthday! Did you enjoy your birthday show?! We already have plans for a continuation, so why don't we present it on your next birthday?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Excellent idea. I'll have to use every trick in my book to make sure Shinonome really enjoys himself.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, we're already working on a sequel?! Let's make it even more exciting and smiley for Akito, then☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
This is the first I'm hearing about this...
Anyway, Shinonome, I'm sure we'll be back to trouble you again, so thanks for always being so patient.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Happy birthday. There's cheesecake in the fridge, so eat it when you get back. I bought it with Airi and the others from a trendy shop.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Akito! You should have seen how focused Ena was picking out a cake for you. Be sure to tell her later if you enjoyed it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday! From what Ena says, you're throwing yourself into your studies and your music. I hope today you can relax and refresh yourself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Proper rest is an important part of both studying and working out. These protein bars are specially formulated to provide BCAA, and should help reduce your fatigue. Please give them a try.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Wow, even Haruka's presents are made for self-improvement... Meanwhile, Honami and I got you these colorful flying disc cookies!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hanasato and I weren't sure what you would like, but then we realized that these would be perfect for the three of us. I really hope you like them, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Happy birthday. I was wondering why Ena was putting so much research into cheesecake... But I see it was for her present to you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Akito! We sang a bunch and ate a ton... Isn't that just how we roll? I was really happy to hear you liked the cheesecake!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shinonome! Today was so much fun. I'm glad we got to sing together. Thanks for everything you do!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Happy birthday. I couldn't be happier to get to celebrate your birthday with so many people, both at school and in SEKAI. Remember, partner, I'm always here for you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks for going to all this trouble, guys.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: First at school, then in SEKAI, it's been one noisy day...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, that's not too bad every once in a while.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But, we can't afford to lose our edge.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We'll take a short break, but once things have settled down, we're going right back to full speed ahead.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, I hope you'll stick around.
Ski Resort

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, you guys.
We're gonna completely bury them in snow.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You still have some snow left on you, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, thanks...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Before you all start huddling up, may I make a suggestion?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A suggestion?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I thought that it'd be fun to throw in a few rules to make our snowball fight more interesting.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, we should probably decide how the winner is going to be declared.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: First, in terms of victory conditions, we'll begin by dividing up this mountain of snowballs between us.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The team that runs out first will be declared the winner. Does that sound good?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, the number of hits we score doesn't matter...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, because some here are more athletic than others. As such, I feel that it's necessary to level the playing field.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
True.
So, just one rule?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, this is where things get interesting.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Any person who is hit five times by the opposing team will incur a penalty and be forbidden from throwing snowballs for thirty seconds.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thirty seconds...?
That doesn't sound very long...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Actually, you could throw a lot of snowballs during that time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, and think about what happens when two people are penalized. It'd be four against two.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If that were to happen, the larger team could suppress the smaller one and get the chance to throw unchecked for a period of time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Th-That'd be terrible!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You all seem to understand the implications.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In addition, there isn't any cover around, so you'll be allowed to guard yourself using your arms and hands. That also goes for protecting your teammates.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: In other words, if we're hit anywhere else, that'll get counted towards our penalty.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, and we'll use the honor system here.
Please make sure to keep a tally of how many times you've been hit.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is that all for the rules, Rui?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We should also huddle up and figure out a plan!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I'll be right there!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, how about we start in five minutes?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It really is incredible how Kamishiro can come up with such detailed rules so quickly.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, he thinks pretty fast.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But I feel like he should be using those wits for other things sometimes...)
Five minutes later

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You guys ready?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we're ready whenever!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let the snowball fight between Vivid BAD SQUAD and Wonderlands×Showtime commence!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Just like we planned!
We're starting with...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wh-What?! M-Me?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (We'll make it look like we're going after her and...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Now!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Eat this!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: There!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-Whaaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Just kidding!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Stand behind me!!
Block-block-block-block!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She just blocked every snowball!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. I had a sneaking suspicion that you'd want to single out Tsukasa first after he got you earlier, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah hah! Looks like Rui's prediction was spot-on!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait! Now's my chance!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Blast!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh no! Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That was your own fault...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Shiver*
No matter! The battle has just begun!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now it's time for us to unleash our plan!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! “Operation: Neverending Barrage” is a go!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That sounds like they're going to throw as many as they can at us...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They're not doing anything special! They're just throwing them! Did you guys even come up with a real plan?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! Either way, we also gotta keep throwing snowballs at them!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're not about to lose, you hear me?!
Street SEKAI
Plaza

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, you guys.
I brought it over.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Awesome! Can we see what's inside?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wow...! It's full of white balls!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Whoa, they're all so soft and squishy!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
They're balls used for soft tennis.
That's why they're so squishy.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But you brought so many.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Gathering all of these couldn't have been easy.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Actually, my friend in the soft tennis club ended up giving us a lot after I asked if they had any balls they didn't need anymore.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But they might be a little dirty since they actually used them for their club activities...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No, that's not a problem at all!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Exactly. What matters most is that we get to experience having a snowball fight!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, you guys wanna have a snowball fight...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, so it'd be great if we were able to borrow that snowball maker you guys just mentioned!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, you need a ton of snow for that thing to work.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
But...
We really want to have a snowball fight.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... Isn't there something we can do for them?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Well...
Our options seem to be to bring snow over or find a suitable substitute for snowballs.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A substitute for snowballs...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Actually, we could...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That was when you came up with the idea of using these balls instead.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I remembered seeing in the news how this one competition didn't have enough snow to hold an actual snowball fight, so they ended up using soft tennis balls instead.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, let's get started.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, no rules?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I can't come up with complicated rules on the fly like Kamishiro. I mean, we don't really need...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: These balls probably won't hurt since they're so soft, but we should still be allowed to block them.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Ta-daa!
I brought a pot lid from the cafe!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I actually brought a frying pan with me♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If a ball comes my way, I'm going to send it out of the park!

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: Cool!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Whoa, hold up!
Now we need to lay down some ground rules!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You can defend yourselves using your arms and hands, but no homers... Don't hit any balls back!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, give me back that lid and pan.

rows.Speaker: KAITO & Luka
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, break into the teams we just decided on.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! Then, on me, Team Rin!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Let's do this, Team Len!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, we'll spend about three minutes on a warm-up fight. After that, we'll do this for real.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ready? Start!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You snooze, you lose!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa! That... Didn't hurt at all!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Now I'm not afraid of getting hit!
Time for my revenge, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Take this! And this! And this!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: W-W-W-Wait, why me?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, KAITO!
All the balls you're deflecting are coming towards me!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Here it comes, Shiraishi!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You don't scare me!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Take this!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Eep! Wh-What happened?!
A ball just fell out of the sky...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, was that one of those disappearing pitches?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, it sort of came straight out of left field, so I suppose...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're tensing up way too much, Toya. Try relaxing your shoulders more.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, Akito, you're not supposed to be giving the other team advice!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Don't be such a spoilsport!
I know your next throw's gonna be a good one, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you! Here it comes, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Honestly...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, hit me with your best shot!
New Year's Day
Shrine Grounds

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I was prepared for a big crowd, but not this big...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Same. I know this shrine is famous, but this is quite a lot of people.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
It's good that we came early, huh?
I guess we just have to wait patiently in line now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Right.
I'll use this time to reply to the message Azusawa and Shiraishi sent.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Their message...?
Oh, right. They said that they're at PXL now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They also said they couldn't wait to see the show.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's New Year's Day, so I hope they get to have as much fun as they can.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Me too. On the other hand, we're having ourselves a pretty lazy day.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, but we should make the most of this shrine visit to ensure that we have another good year.
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The shrine's office was also pretty crowded, huh.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I guess that's normal, since everyone goes to draw their fortunes after making their wishes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That being said, we've managed to pay our respects and get our fortunes. That means we've accomplished our goals for the day.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, but now it's time to see how lucky we really are.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, I got a great blessing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Really? So did I.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Seriously?
Not a bad way to start off the new year.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Let's see what it says... “Your studies will go smoothly. There is no need to fear.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Do you think it's talking about our English lessons?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
If so, that's very encouraging.
You should do as it says. Proceed without any fear.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, not very likely...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, what else does it say...? “Your next trip will be very rewarding.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Mine also says something similar.
We may gain quite a lot by going over to the United States.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I sure hope so. There wouldn't be much point otherwise.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What is it?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, they just sent a message.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, Shiraishi and Azusawa. They even included a photo.

rows.Speaker: An's Message
rows.Line:
<Check it out!
We got to greet Kagami Mochi Phenny!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Message
rows.Line: <Will you be able to get your pancakes? Are you two still at the shrine?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This is Kagami Mochi Phenny...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's this on his head? A mandarin...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, this must be one of the key features of Kagami Mochi Phenny.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It looks like all they did was place a mandarin on top of a white ball of fluff and call it kagami mochi... Though, I guess the pancakes we're gonna have later are basically the same idea.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's up?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, it's just... They sent us a photo, so I feel like we should reply by sending one.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We both just got great blessings, so I thought it might be good to let them know.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Do we have to? We're not little kids anymore.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We can hold our fortunes out like this and hold the camera from this angle. That should allow us to squeeze both of our faces in...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're serious...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, fine... Gimme your phone. I'll take it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you, Akito.
Are we both in frame?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, we are.
Anyway, smile...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, it turned out pretty well. Nice work, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, good for you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, let's send this to them and start heading over to the cafe.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's go.
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry I'm late.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, there you are!
That's fine, but what's going on?
We waited here like you asked.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I had to go back and get this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A cake box?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, call it a little treat.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: A treat?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Something sweet after a tough practice doesn't sound bad, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, can we open it?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, cheesecake! And it looks amazing!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This cake... Is it the one from...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yup.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, what are you guys talking about? Do you know where this came from, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's the cake Akito and Momoi won when we played competitive Hanetsuki together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ena and I ended up losing to them, which meant that we had to treat them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you played for cheesecake?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, Ena... My sister likes this a lot, but I decided to get some more, since it ended up being so good.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
And you got enough for all of us?
That's so thoughtful of you, Akito!

rows.Line: More importantly, you guys went over to the United States, right? Anything cool happen?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's a pretty broad question.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I mean, we ran into our fair share of trouble.
We couldn't stay at the hotel we thought we had booked, and I had my wallet stolen.

rows.Speaker: Soccer Team Member
rows.Line: Haha. That's terrible. But sounds like you had fun!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
How...?
Still, all that stuff aside, it actually was fun.

rows.Speaker: Soccer Team Member
rows.Line: That's pretty cool. I still can't believe that you took a trip overseas. I mean, you had to speak in English, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Fortunately, I had Toya and a few others there to help me out. Some of the people we met could even speak Japanese.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But you did just fine by yourself when you bought things at the airport and elsewhere.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, that was just me stringing together simple sentences...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Considering what we wanna do in the future, I need to buckle down and get better at it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, we gotta keep doing our best there.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, after spending a day at school, I feel like I should cherish the time I get to spend here more...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I thought that as well.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We can just talk without really working at it, and people will understand where we're coming from...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thinking about it that way, it's rather reassuring, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I more or less get what you're trying to say...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I also felt that a little after coming to school for the first time in a while.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'd taken that for granted until now, but it's something that I really shouldn't...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, why don't you make an exception today?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Why don't you go and help the soccer team?

rows.Speaker: Soccer Team Member
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, how did you guys land on that...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It's a part of us cherishing our time here.
Also, it's important to take your mind off of things every once in a while.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Yeah, I guess every once in a while...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: When the others get back, are you guys gonna have a quick match?

rows.Speaker: Soccer Team Member
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, that's right...
Does this mean you're gonna join us?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, for a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Soccer Team Member
rows.Line: Thanks! You're the best!

rows.Speaker: Soccer Team Member
rows.Line: Try to get warmed up before the others get back!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, I will.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: In that case, Toya, we should go watch them!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's do that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You two aren't going home?
Don't come crying to me if the ball goes flying towards you guys.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll do my best to dodge it if it does...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! You'll be fine! I'll just kick it away!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh? I'd like to see that.

rows.Speaker: Soccer Team Member
rows.Line: Alright, Akito, I'll help you get warmed up!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, you better. I'm expecting at least that much of you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I guess doing stuff like this every once in a while isn't so bad...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll go and start getting ready.
